body.translated_text: What is to be received should then be received; one should not make expenditures here.

body.text: p.95.2ab/.sandhipālān dvāra^pālāṃl lekhakāṃś ca prayojayet/
body.translated_text: One should employ border-guards, gate-keepers, and scribes.

body.text: p.95.2cd/.bhiṣakkarma ca kurvīta bhaiṣajyāni ca saṃharet//
body.translated_text: One should perform medical work and collect medicines.

body.text: p.95.3ab/.nidhiṃ vā khānayet tatra nidadhyād api vā nidhiṃ/
body.translated_text: One should dig for a treasure there, or also deposit a treasure.

body.text: p.95.3cd/.dhanaṃ ca^atra prayuñjīta bhiṣakkarma ca śikṣayet//
body.translated_text: One should invest wealth here and teach the medical art.

body.text: p.95.4ab/.athātra mṛgayen naṣṭaṃ labhyate tac cirād api/
body.translated_text: And what is lost here — if sought, it is recovered even after a long time.

body.text: p.95.4cd/.arogī krodhanaś ca^atra svapnaśīlaś ca jāyate/
body.translated_text: One born here is healthy, wrathful, and inclined to sleep.

body.text: p.95.4ef/.pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭim abhinirdiśet//śatabhiṣāyāṃ//
body.translated_text: Regarding the rainfall of the god, one should predict good rainfall. // [Under <s>Śatabhiṣā</s>] //

body.text: p.95.5ab/.pūrvabhādrapadāyoge krūrāṇāṃ siddhir ucyate/
body.translated_text: Under the conjunction of <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>, the accomplishment of cruel [rites] is declared.

body.text: p.95.5cd/.naṣṭaviddhopataptaṃ vā naitad asti^iti nirdiśet//
body.translated_text: What is lost, struck, or afflicted should be predicted as 'it does not exist.'

body.text: p.95.6ab/.dīrghaśrotro mahā^bhogo jñātīnāṃ ca sadā^priyaḥ/
body.translated_text: One born here has long ears, great enjoyments, and is always dear to kinsmen,

body.text: p.95.6cd/.mahā^dhano +akrūrakarmā niḥkrohaś ca^atra jāyate/
body.translated_text: very wealthy, not engaged in cruel deeds, and without deceit.

body.text: p.95.6ef/.pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya caṇḍāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ samādiśet//pūrvabhādrapade//
body.translated_text: Regarding the rainfall of the god, one should predict violent rainfall. // [Under <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>] //

body.text: p.96.1ab/.uttarasyāṃ tu kurvīta; āyuṣyaṃ puṣṭikarma ca/
body.translated_text: Under the latter (<s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s>), one should perform rites for longevity and nourishment.

body.text: p.96.1cd/.na ca dakṣinato gacchet puraṃ ca^atra pradāpayet//
body.translated_text: One should not travel southward, and one should make charitable donations here.

body.text: p.96.2ab/.āyuṣmāṃś ca yaśasvī ca dhanavāṃś ca^atra jāyate/
body.translated_text: One born here is long-lived, famous, and wealthy.

body.text: p.96.2cd/.atra^api triguṇaṃ vinded ādānaṃ yadi vā vyayaṃ/
body.translated_text: Here too, one obtains threefold [results] — whether in receipts or expenditures.

body.text: p.96.2ef/.pravarṣaṇaṃ ca devasya suvṛṣṭim abhinirdiśet//uttarabhādrapade//
body.translated_text: Regarding the rainfall of the god, one should predict good rainfall. // [Under <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s>] //

body.text: p.96.3ab/.revatyāṃ ratna rajataṃ dhana^dhānyaṃ prayojayet/
body.translated_text: Under <s>Revatī</s>, one should employ gems, silver, wealth, and grain.

body.text: p.96.3cd/.koṣṭha^āgārāṇi kurvīta kiṇvaṃ ca^atra na kārayet//
body.translated_text: One should build storehouses and granaries, and should not prepare fermented drink here.

body.text: p.96.4ab/.surākarma ca kurvīta hiraṇyaṃ govrajāni ca/
body.translated_text: One should prepare liquor, and [deal with] gold and cattle-pens.

body.text: p.96.4cd/.gosaṅghaṃ sthāpayec ca^atra gośālāṃ ca^atra kārayet/
body.translated_text: One should establish a herd of cattle here and build a cow-shed here.

body.text: p.96.4ef/.ācchādayen navaṃ vastraṃ hiraṇyam api dhārayet//
body.translated_text: One should put on new garments and also wear gold ornaments.

body.text: p.96.5ab/.bhikṣuko dānaśīlaś ca daridraś ca^anasūyakaḥ/
body.translated_text: One born here is a mendicant, charitable, poor, and free from envy,

body.text: p.96.5cd/.jñātīnāṃ sevako nityaṃ dharma^jñaś ca^atra jāyate/
body.translated_text: always a servant of kinsmen, and a knower of <s>dharma</s>.

body.text: p.96.5ef/.suvṛṣṭiṃ naṣṭa^lābhaṃ ca revatyām abhinirdiśet//revatyāṃ//
body.translated_text: Good rainfall and recovery of what is lost should be predicted under <s>Revatī</s>. // [Under <s>Revatī</s>] //

body.text: p.97.1ab/.strī^puṃsam aśvinā yuñjyād aśvaśālāṃ ca kārayet/
body.translated_text: Under <s>Aśvinī</s>, one should pair men and women, and should build a horse-stable.

body.text: p.97.1cd/.aśvān prayojayed atra rathaṃ ca^atra prayojayet//
body.translated_text: One should employ horses here and use chariots here.

body.text: p.97.2ab/.ṛṇaḥ prayogaḥ kartavyo bījāny atra pravāpayet/
body.translated_text: Lending and borrowing should be done; seeds should be sown here.

body.text: p.97.2cd/.yānāni ca hayān damyān dantinaś ca prayojayet//
body.translated_text: One should employ vehicles, horses being trained, and elephants.

body.text: p.97.3ab/.bhaiṣajyaṃ bhojayed atra bhiṣakkarma ca kārayet/
body.translated_text: One should administer medicine here and have medical work done.

body.text: p.97.3cd/.medhāvī darśanīyaś ca rāja^yogyaś ca sampadā//
body.translated_text: One born here is intelligent, good-looking, suited for royal service with prosperity,

body.text: p.97.4ab/.arogo balavāṃc chūraḥ subhago hy atra jāyate/
body.translated_text: healthy, strong, heroic, and fortunate.

body.text: p.97.4cd/.suvṛṣṭiṃ naṣṭa^lābhaṃ ca; aśvinyām abhinirdiśet//aśvinyāṃ//
body.translated_text: Good rainfall and recovery of what is lost should be predicted under <s>Aśvinī</s>. // [Under <s>Aśvinī</s>] //

body.text: p.97.5ab/.tritārāṃ bharaṇīṃ vidyāt krūrakarmāṇi sādhayet/
body.translated_text: One should know <s>Bharaṇī</s> as a three-starred [constellation] and should accomplish cruel works.

body.text: p.97.5cd/.bhṛtyāṃś ca bhṛtakāṃś ca^api vṛṇuyād darśayet tathā//
body.translated_text: One should select and employ servants and hired workers and also display [armies].

body.text: p.97.6ab/.bhūtiṃ ca^upanayed atra bhāryāṃ ca na vivāhayet/
body.translated_text: One should bring wealth here, but should not marry a wife.

body.text: p.97.6cd/.utkaṭako vañcatakaḥ kūṭasākṣī ca tandrijaḥ//
body.translated_text: One born here is cunning, deceitful, a false witness, and sluggish,

body.text: p.98.1ab/.vidhijñaḥ pāpacāritraḥ kadaryaś ca^atra jāyate/
body.translated_text: knowledgeable of rules but of sinful conduct, and miserly.

body.text: p.98.1cd/.jāyate ca^atra duḥśīlo gurūṇām abhyasūyakaḥ/
body.translated_text: And one born here is of wicked character, envious of elders,

body.text: p.98.1ef/.paropatāpī lubdhaś ca paravyāhāragocaraḥ//bharaṇyāṃ//
body.translated_text: a tormentor of others, greedy, and dependent on others' speech. // [Under <s>Bharaṇī</s>] //

body.text: p.98.2ab/.saptaviṃśati^nakṣatre kṛttikādi yadā bhavet/
body.translated_text: When the twenty-seven <s>nakṣatras</s>, beginning with <s>Kṛttikā</s>

body.text: p.98.2cd/.bharaṇyantāni; ṛkṣāṇīmāṃ pratipādayet kriyāṃ//
body.translated_text: and ending with <s>Bharaṇī</s>, [are in conjunction] — one should apply this procedure to the constellations.

body.text: p.98.3ab/.teṣāṃ madhye yadā sarve śasyāny oṣadhayo +api ca/
body.translated_text: Among them, when all crops, herbs,

body.text: p.98.3cd/.vanaspatayaś ca pīḍyante yatrāsau tiṣṭhate grahaḥ/
body.translated_text: and forest trees are afflicted — wherever that planet stands,

body.text: p.98.3ef/.sarvaṃ pratipādayitavyam ukta^nakṣatra^karmasu//
body.translated_text: everything should be applied in accordance with the stated <s>nakṣatra</s> activities.

body.text: p.98.4/.ukto nakṣatra^karma^nirdeśo nāma^adhyāyaḥ//
body.translated_text: Thus is stated the chapter called 'The Instruction on <s>Nakṣatra</s> Activities.'

body.text: % dhruva^kṣipra^ardha^rātrikāṇi nakṣatrāṇi
body.translated_text: % Fixed, swift, and midnight <s>nakṣatras</s>

body.text: p.98.5/.catvāri bhoḥ puṣkarasārin nakṣatrāṇi dhruvāṇi bhavanti tāni vyākhyāsyāmi/ tac chṛṇu/ tad yathā/ trīṇi uttarāṇi rohiṇī ca/ kṣeme +adhyāvaset/ (99) bījāni ca^atra ropayed/ niveśataṃ ca^atra kalpayet/ rājānaṃ ca^abhiṣiñcayet/ yāni ca^anyāni uktāni karmāṇi tāni kārayet/
body.translated_text: O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, there are four fixed <s>nakṣatras</s> (lunar mansions). I shall explain them. Listen to that. They are as follows: the three <s>Uttarā</s> (mansions) and <s>Rohiṇī</s>. Under these, one should settle in safety, plant seeds, establish a dwelling place, consecrate a king, and perform whatever other actions have been prescribed.

body.text: p.99.1ab/.atha naṣṭaṃ dagdhaṃ vā viddhaṃ ca^api hṛtaṃ ca vā/
body.translated_text: Now, what is lost, burnt, pierced, or stolen —

body.text: p.99.1cd/.evam abhinirdiṣṭāṃ vā svasti kṣipraṃ bhaviṣyati//
body.translated_text: if declared under these (mansions), well-being will come quickly.

body.text: p.99.2ab/.athātra jāto dhanyo +asau vidyātmā ca yaśasvī ca/
body.translated_text: And one born here will be fortunate, learned, and renowned;

body.text: p.99.2cd/.maṅgalīyo mahā^bhogī mahā^yogī bhaviṣyati//
body.translated_text: he will be auspicious, a great enjoyer, and a great <s>yogin</s>.

body.text: p.99.3/.catvāri bhoḥ puṣkarasārin nakṣatrāṇi kṣiprāni bhavanti/ tad yathā puṣyo hastābhijid aśvino ceti/ eṣu kṣiprāṇi karmāṇi kārayec ca vicakṣaṇaḥ/ svādhyāyaṃ mantra^samārambhaṃ pravāsa^prasthānaṃ gāś ca turaṅgān apy atra yojayet/ dhūyāṇi yuktakarmāṇi ca^oṣadhīkarmāṇi ca/ bheṣajyāni sarvāṇy atra prayojayet/
body.translated_text: O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, there are four swift <s>nakṣatras</s>. They are as follows: <s>Puṣya</s>, <s>Hasta</s>, <s>Abhijit</s>, and <s>Aśvinī</s>. Under these, the wise one should have swift actions performed: <s>svādhyāya</s> (self-study), the commencement of mantras, setting out on a journey, and one should also yoke cows and horses. (Also) fumigating actions, acts performed under the yoke (of the stars), and herbal operations — all medicines should be applied under these.

body.text: p.99.4/.tatra yajña^samārambhaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ ca kārayet/ athātra naṣṭaṃ dagdhaṃ vā viddhaṃ vā svasti bhaviṣyati^iti vaktavyaṃ/
body.translated_text: Under these, the commencement of a sacrifice and the <s>Cāturmāsya</s> (four-monthly rites) should be performed. And if something is lost, burnt, or pierced under these, it should be declared that well-being will come.

body.text: p.99.5ab/.athātra jātakaṃ vidyān maṅgalīyaṃ yaśasvinaṃ/
body.translated_text: And one born here should be known as auspicious and renowned,

body.text: p.99.5cd/.mahā^bhogaṃ ca rājānaṃ mahā^yoginam īśvaraṃ//
body.translated_text: a king of great enjoyment, a great <s>yogin</s>, a sovereign,

body.text: p.99.6ab/.mahā^dhanaṃ mahā^bhogaṃ tathā ca mahad^uttamaṃ/
body.translated_text: of great wealth, of great enjoyment, and also of great eminence,

body.text: p.99.6cd/.kṣatriyaṃ dānaśīlaṃ ca brahmaṇaṃ ca purohitaṃ//iti/
body.translated_text: a <s>kṣatriya</s> (warrior) generous by nature, or a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> serving as a <s>purohita</s> (royal priest). Thus.

body.text: p.99.7/.pañca khalu bhoḥ puṣkarasārin nakṣatrāni dāruṇāni bhavanti/tad yathā/
body.translated_text: O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, there are indeed five fierce <s>nakṣatras</s>. They are as follows:

body.text: p.99.8ab/.maghā trīṇi ca pūrvāṇi bharaṇī ceti pañcamī/
body.translated_text: <s>Maghā</s>, the three <s>Pūrvā</s> (mansions), and <s>Bharaṇī</s> as the fifth.

body.text: p.99.8cd/.athātra dagdhaṃ naṣṭaṃ vā viddhaṃ vā na bhaviṣyati//
body.translated_text: If something is burnt, lost, or pierced under these, it will not recover.

body.text:
p.99.9/.iti vaktavyaṃ / ardha^rātrikāṇi ṣaṭ/ tad yathā/ ārdrā aśleṣā svātī jyeṣṭhā (100)śatabhiṣā bharaṇī ceti/ navaṃśāḥ ṣaḍgrāsā dvikṣetrāṇi/ rohiṇī punarvasur viśākhā ca/ trīṇī uttarāṇi ceti/ ubhayato vibhāgāni/ pañca^daśakṣetrāṇi/ kṛttikā ca maghā mūlā grīṇi pūrvāṇi/ imāni ṣaṭ pūrvabhāgināni/ mṛgaśirā puṣyā hastā citrā anurādhā śravaṇā dhaniṣṭhā revatī
aśvino ceti/ imāni nava nakṣatrāṇi paścād bhāgīyāni triṃśan^muhūrta^yogāni kṣetrāṇi ca/
body.translated_text: Thus it should be declared. The midnight (mansions) are six, namely: <s>Ārdrā</s>, <s>Āśleṣā</s>, <s>Svātī</s>, <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, <s>Śatabhiṣā</s>, and <s>Bharaṇī</s>. The <s>navāṃśas</s> (ninth-parts) are six divisions, two fields: <s>Rohiṇī</s>, <s>Punarvasu</s>, and <s>Viśākhā</s>, and the three <s>Uttarā</s> (mansions). These are divided on both sides. Fifteen fields: <s>Kṛttikā</s>, <s>Maghā</s>, <s>Mūlā</s>, and the three <s>Pūrvā</s> — these six belong to the earlier portion. <s>Mṛgaśirā</s>, <s>Puṣya</s>, <s>Hasta</s>, <s>Citrā</s>, <s>Anurādhā</s>, <s>Śravaṇā</s>, <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>, <s>Revatī</s>, and <s>Aśvinī</s> — these nine <s>nakṣatras</s> belong to the later portion, with thirty <s>muhūrta</s> conjunctions and fields.

body.text: p.100.1/.api ca brāhmaṇa śubhāś ca muhūrtā bhavanti/ aśubhāś ca muhūrtā bhavanti/ śubha^aśubhāś ca muhūrtā bhavanti/ saṃprayuktanakṣatreṣu sarveṣu yadā śubha^muhūrta^samāpattayo bhavanti tadā śobhanā bhavanti/ yadā +aśubha^muhūrtasamāpattayo bhavanti tadā na śobhanā bhavanti/ yadā tu punaḥ śubhāś ca^aśubhāś ca samāpattayo bhavanti tadā sādhāranā bhavanti/
body.translated_text: Furthermore, O <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, there are auspicious <s>muhūrtas</s> (time-units), inauspicious <s>muhūrtas</s>, and mixed auspicious-inauspicious <s>muhūrtas</s>. In all the conjoined <s>nakṣatras</s>, when there are confluences of auspicious <s>muhūrtas</s>, they are splendid. When there are confluences of inauspicious <s>muhūrtas</s>, they are not splendid. But when there are both auspicious and inauspicious confluences, they are ordinary.

body.text: %rātridivasayor hrāsavṛddhī
body.translated_text: The waning and waxing of night and day:

body.text:
p.100.2/.athātra kathaṃ rātridivasānāṃ hrāso vṛddhir vā bhavati^iti tad ucyate/ varṣāṇāṃ prathame māse puṣya^nakṣatram amāvāsyāṃ bhavati/ śravaṇā pūrṇamāsyāṃ/ aṣṭādaśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati/ dvādaśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ ṣoḍaśāṅgula^kāṣṭhasya madhyāhne +ardhāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ āṣāḍhā rātriṃ nayati/ mṛgaśirasi ādityo gato bhavati/ varṣāṇāṃ
dvitīye māse maghā +amāvāsyāṃ bhavati bhādrapadā pūrṇamāsyāṃ/ saptadaśa muhūrto divaso bhavati/ trayodaśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ (101) dvi^aṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ śravaṇā rātriṃ nayati/ puṣya ādityo gato bhavati/ varṣāṇāṃ tṛtīye māse phalgunyam amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati/ aśvinī pūrṇamāsyāṃ/ ṣoḍaśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati/ catur^daśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ catur^aṅgulāyāṃ
chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ pūrvabhādrapadā rātriṃ nayati/ maghā^ādityo gato bhavati/ varṣāṇāṃ caturthe māse citrām amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati kṛttikā pūrṇamāsyāṃ/ pañca^daśa^muhūrto bhavati divasaḥ/ pañca^daśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ ṣaḍaṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ aśvino rātriṃ nayati/ phalugunyām ādityo gato bhavati/
body.translated_text: Now, how does the waning and waxing of nights and days occur? This is explained. In the first month of the rainy season, the <s>nakṣatra</s> <s>Puṣya</s> falls on the new moon, and <s>Śravaṇā</s> on the full moon. The day is eighteen <s>muhūrtas</s> long, the night twelve <s>muhūrtas</s>. At midday, when the shadow of a sixteen-<s>aṅgula</s> (finger-breadth) stick is half an <s>aṅgula</s>, the sun turns. <s>Āṣāḍhā</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Mṛgaśiras</s>. In the second month of the rainy season, <s>Maghā</s> falls on the new moon and <s>Bhādrapadā</s> on the full moon. The day is seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night thirteen <s>muhūrtas</s>. The sun turns when the shadow is two <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Śravaṇā</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Puṣya</s>. In the third month of the rainy season, <s>Phalgunī</s> falls on the new moon, <s>Aśvinī</s> on the full moon. The day is sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night fourteen <s>muhūrtas</s>. The sun turns when the shadow is four <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Maghā</s>. In the fourth month of the rainy season, <s>Citrā</s> falls on the new moon and <s>Kṛttikā</s> on the full moon. The day is fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>. The sun turns when the shadow is six <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Aśvinī</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Phalgunī</s>.

body.text:
p.101.1/.hemantānāṃ prathame māse +anurādhā +amāvāsyaṃ bhavati/ mṛgaśirā pūrṇamāsyāṃ/ catur^daśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati/ ṣoḍaśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ aṣṭāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ kṛttikā rātriṃ nayati/ citrāyām ādityo gato bhavati/ hemantānāṃ dvitīye māse +amāvāsyāṃ jyeṣṭhā bhavati/ puṣyaḥ pūrṇamāsyāṃ/ trayodaśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati/ saptadaśa^muhūrtā
rātriḥ/ daśāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ mṛgaśirā rātriṃ nayati/ viśākhāyām ādityo gato bhavati/ (102) hemantānāṃ tṛtīye māse pūrvāṣāḍhām avāsyāṃ bhavati/ maghā pūrṇamāsyaṃ/ dvādaśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati/ aṣṭādaśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ dvādaśāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ puṣyo rātriṃ nayati/ jyeṣṭhāyām ādityo gato bhavati/ hemantānāṃ caturthe
māse śravaṇām āvāsyaṃ bhavati/ phalgunī pūrṇamāsyāṃ/ trayodaśa muhūrto divaso bhavati/ saptadaśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ daśāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ maghā rātriṃ nayati/ āṣāḍhāyām ādityo gato bhavati/
body.translated_text: In the first month of winter, <s>Anurādhā</s> falls on the new moon and <s>Mṛgaśirā</s> on the full moon. The day is fourteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s>. The sun turns when the shadow is eight <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Kṛttikā</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Citrā</s>. In the second month of winter, <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> falls on the new moon and <s>Puṣya</s> on the full moon. The day is thirteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s>. The sun turns when the shadow is ten <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Mṛgaśirā</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Viśākhā</s>. In the third month of winter, <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s> falls on the new moon and <s>Maghā</s> on the full moon. The day is twelve <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night eighteen <s>muhūrtas</s>. The sun turns when the shadow is twelve <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Puṣya</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>. In the fourth month of winter, <s>Śravaṇā</s> falls on the new moon and <s>Phalgunī</s> on the full moon. The day is thirteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s>. The sun turns when the shadow is ten <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Maghā</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Āṣāḍhā</s>.

body.text:
p.102.1/.grīṣmāṇāṃ prathame māse uttarabhādrapadām āvāsyayaṃ bhavati/ citrā pūrṇamāsyāṃ catur^daśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati/ ṣoḍaśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ (103) aṣṭāṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ phalgunī rātriṃ nayati/ śravaṇāyām ādityo gato bhavati/ grīṣmāṇāṃ dvitīye māse +aśvinī amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati/ viśākhā pūrṇamāsyāṃ/ pañca^daśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati/
pañca^daśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ ṣaḍaṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ citrā rātriṃ nayati/ uttarāyāṃ bhādrapadāyām ādityo gato bhavati/ grīṣmānāṃ tṛtīye māse kṛttikām amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati/ jyeṣṭhā pūrṇamāsyāṃ/ ṣoḍaśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati/ caturdaśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ catur^aṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityāḥ parivartate/ viśākhā rātriṃ nayati/ kṛttikāyām ādityo gato
bhavati/ grīṣmāṇāṃ caturthe māse mṛgaśirā amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati/ uttarāṣāḍhā pūrṇamāsyāṃ/ saptadaśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati/ trayodaśa^muhūrtā rātriḥ/ madhyāhne dvi^aṅgulāyāṃ chāyāyām ādityaḥ parivartate/ jyeṣṭhā rātriṃ nayati/ puṣya ādityo gato bhavati/
body.translated_text: In the first month of summer, <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s> falls on the new moon and <s>Citrā</s> on the full moon. The day is fourteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s>. The sun turns when the shadow is eight <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Phalgunī</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Śravaṇā</s>. In the second month of summer, <s>Aśvinī</s> falls on the new moon and <s>Viśākhā</s> on the full moon. The day is fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>. The sun turns when the shadow is six <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Citrā</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Uttarābhādrapadā</s>. In the third month of summer, <s>Kṛttikā</s> falls on the new moon and <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> on the full moon. The day is sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night fourteen <s>muhūrtas</s>. The sun turns when the shadow is four <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Viśākhā</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Kṛttikā</s>. In the fourth month of summer, <s>Mṛgaśirā</s> falls on the new moon and <s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s> on the full moon. The day is seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s>, the night thirteen <s>muhūrtas</s>. At midday, the sun turns when the shadow is two <s>aṅgulas</s>. <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> governs the night. The sun is in <s>Puṣya</s>.

body.text:
p.103.1/.saṃvatsaram anveṣaṇato muhūrtaviśeṣaṇaiḥ sarvāṇi ca^etāni (nakṣatāṇi) bhāgānubhagena^amāvāsyayaṃ pūrṇamāsyaṃ ca yujyante/ ūnarātrasya pūrṇarātrasya ca grahītavyaṃ/ tatra tṛtīye varṣe +adhiko māso yujyate/ ṣaṇṇāṃ māsānām ahorātrāṇi samāni bhavanti/ ataḥ ṣaṇ^māsād divaso vadhate/ ṣaṇ^māsād rātrir (104) vardhate/ ṣaṇ^māsād divaso māse māse samam eva
hīyate/ ṣaṇ^māsād rātrir māse māse parihīyate/
body.translated_text: Throughout the year, by searching with the particularities of <s>muhūrtas</s>, all these <s>nakṣatras</s> are joined to the new moon and the full moon by their respective portions. The incomplete and complete (lunar) fortnights are to be taken into account. Therein, in the third year, an intercalary month is added. For six months, days and nights are equal. After six months, the day increases; after six months, the night increases. For six months, the day diminishes equally month by month; for six months, the night diminishes month by month.

body.text: p.104.1/.ṣaṇ^māsād ādityaḥ parivartate/ uttarāṃ diśaṃ saṃcarati/ ṣaṇ^māsād dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ/ ṣaṇ^māsāt samud(r)e udakaparimāṇasya hrāso vṛddhiś ca bhavati/ sūrya^gatyā candra^gatyā ca samudra^udaka^velā^abhivṛddhir bhavati/ atra gaṇanāpratijāgaraṇāsmaram ity evam eṣa saṃvatsaro vyākhyāto bhavati/
body.translated_text: For six months, the sun turns and moves toward the northern direction; for six months, toward the southern direction. Over six months, there is a decrease and increase in the volume of ocean water. By the course of the sun and the course of the moon, the flooding of the ocean waters increases. Here, the computation, vigilance, and memory (of all this) — thus this year has been explained.

body.text: %grahaḥ
body.translated_text: The Planets:

body.text: p.104.2/.candra ādityaḥ śukro bṛhaspatiḥ śanaiścaro +aṅgārako budhaś ca/ ime grahāḥ/ eṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ saṃvatsarasthāyo/ evaṃ śanaiścaro budho +aṅgārakaḥ śukraś ca^ime maṇḍala^cāriṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: The Moon, the Sun, <s>Śukra</s> (Venus), <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter), <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn), <s>Aṅgāraka</s> (Mars), and <s>Budha</s> (Mercury) — these are the planets. Among these planets, <s>Bṛhaspati</s> stays for one year (in each sign). Likewise <s>Śanaiścara</s>, <s>Budha</s>, <s>Aṅgāraka</s>, and <s>Śukra</s> — these are the ones that travel in orbits.

body.text: %nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ
body.translated_text: The Circle of <s>Nakṣatras</s>:

body.text:
p.104.3/.bharaṇī kṛttikā rohiṇī mṛgaśirā etat sādhāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ/ ārdrā punarvasuḥ puṣyo +aśleṣā etat sādhāranaṃ dvitīyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ/ maghā atha phalgunadvayaṃ hasto citrā etat sādhāraṇaṃ tṛtīyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ/ svātī viśākhā anurādhā etat sādhāraṇaṃ caturthaṃ maṇḍalaṃ/ jyeṣṭhā mūlāṣāḍhādvayam (105) atra sarvāṇi mahā^bhāyāni bhavanti/ idaṃ pañcamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ/
abhijic chravaṇā dhaniṣṭhā śatabiṣā ubhe bhādrapade caitat sādhāraṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ/ revatī avinī caitat sādhāraṇaṃ saptamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ/ saṃvatsaram eteṣu yad yan nakṣatra^maṇḍalaṃ pīḍayati tasya tasya janapadasya sattvasya vā pīḍā nirdeṣṭavyā/
body.translated_text: <s>Bharaṇī</s>, <s>Kṛttikā</s>, <s>Rohiṇī</s>, <s>Mṛgaśirā</s> — this is the first ordinary circle. <s>Ārdrā</s>, <s>Punarvasu</s>, <s>Puṣya</s>, <s>Āśleṣā</s> — this is the second ordinary circle. <s>Maghā</s>, then the two <s>Phalgunīs</s>, <s>Hasta</s>, <s>Citrā</s> — this is the third ordinary circle. <s>Svātī</s>, <s>Viśākhā</s>, <s>Anurādhā</s> — this is the fourth ordinary circle. <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, <s>Mūlā</s>, the two <s>Āṣāḍhās</s> — in this (circle) all the great terrors occur; this is the fifth circle. <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Śravaṇā</s>, <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>, <s>Śatabhiṣā</s>, and the two <s>Bhādrapadās</s> — this is the sixth ordinary circle. <s>Revatī</s> and <s>Aśvinī</s> — this is the seventh ordinary circle. Throughout the year, whichever <s>nakṣatra</s> circle afflicts (a region), the affliction of that country or that creature is to be declared.

body.text: p.105.1/.dvādaśa^muhūrtāni divase dhruvāṇi dvādaśa rātrau/ ṣaṇ^muhūrtāḥ sañcāriṇaḥ/ katame ṣaṭ/ nairṛto varuṇo vāyavo bhargo devo raudro vicārī ca/ itīme sañcāriṇaḥ ṣaṭ/
body.translated_text: There are twelve fixed <s>muhūrtas</s> in the day and twelve at night. Six <s>muhūrtas</s> are wandering. Which six? <s>Nairṛta</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Vāyava</s>, <s>Bharga</s>, <s>Deva</s>, <s>Raudra</s>, and <s>Vicārī</s> — these are the six wandering ones.

body.text:
p.105.2/.athātra śrāvaṇe māse pūrṇe +aṣṭādaśa^muhūrte divase sūrya^udaye ca caturojā nāma muhūrto bhavati/ rohitasya ca muhūrtasya balasya ca^antare madhyāhno bhavati/ sūryāvatāre tu vicārī nāma muhūrto bhavati/ dvādaśa^muhūrtāyāṃ rātrāv avatīrṇe sūrye ṣaṣṭhe muhūrte nayamano nāma muhūrto bhavati/ ātāpāgnir evaṃ nāma muhūrto rātryavasāne bhavati/ bhādrapade
māse pūrṇe saptadaśa^muhūrte divase sūrya^udaye ca caturojā evaṃ nāma muhūrtā bhavati/ madhyāhne +abhijito nāma muhūrto bhavati/ (106) sūryāvatāre raudro nāma muhūrto bhavati/ trayodaśa^muhūrtāyāṃ rātrāv avatīrṇe sūrye vicārī nāma muhūrto bhavati/ ardha^rātre mahā^bhayo vāyāvo nāma muhūrto bhavati/
body.translated_text: Now, in the month of <s>Śrāvaṇa</s>, when the day is a full eighteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Caturojā</s> occurs. Between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Rohita</s> and <s>Bala</s>, midday falls. At sunset, the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Vicārī</s> occurs. In the twelve-<s>muhūrta</s> night, after the sun has set, at the sixth <s>muhūrta</s> the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Nayamāna</s> occurs. The <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Ātāpāgni</s> occurs at the end of the night. In the month of <s>Bhādrapada</s>, when the day is a full seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s>, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Caturojā</s> occurs. At midday, the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Abhijit</s> occurs. At sunset, the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Raudra</s> occurs. In the thirteen-<s>muhūrta</s> night, after the sun has set, the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Vicārī</s> occurs. At midnight, the greatly fearful <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Vāyava</s> occurs.

body.text: p.106.1/.rātryavasāne ātapāgnir evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/ aśvayuje māse pūrṇe ṣoḍaśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati/ sūrya^udaye caturojā nāma muhūrto bhavati/ samudgatasya ca muhūrtasya abhijitasya ca^antare madhyāhno bhavati/ sūryāvatāre bhargo devo nāma muhūrto bhavati/
body.translated_text: At the end of the night, the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Ātapāgni</s> occurs. In the month of <s>Āśvayuja</s>, when the day is a full sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Caturojā</s> occurs. Between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Samudgata</s> and <s>Abhijit</s>, midday falls. At sunset, the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Bharga Deva</s> occurs.

body.text: p.106.2/.catur^daśa^muhūrtāyāṃ rātrāv avatīrṇe sūrye raudro nāma muhūrto bhavati/ abhijitasya ca muhūrtasya bhīṣamāṇasya ca muhūrtasya antareṇa^ardha^rātraṃ bhavati/ rātryavasāne ātapāgnir evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/
body.translated_text: In the fourteen-<s>muhūrta</s> night, after the sun has set, the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Raudra</s> occurs. Between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Abhijit</s> and <s>Bhīṣamāṇa</s>, midnight falls. At the end of the night, the <s>muhūrta</s> named <s>Ātapāgni</s> occurs.

body.text:
p.106.3/.kārttike māse pūrṇe divasaḥ samarātrir bhavati/ pañca^daśa^muhūrto divaso bhavati pañca^daśa^muhūrto rātriḥ/ samāne +ahorātre sūrya^udaye caturojā evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/ saṃmukho nāma muhūrto bhavati madhyāhne/ santato nāma muhūrtaḥ (107) sūryāvatāre/ rātrāv avatīrṇamātra sūrye bhrgo devo nāma muhūrto bhavati/ ardha^rātre +abhijin muhūrto bhavati/
rātryavasāne ātapāgnir evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/
body.translated_text: In the full month of <s>Kārttika</s>, the day is equal to the night. The day has fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s> (time-units) and the night has fifteen <s>muhūrtas</s>. When day and night are equal, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Caturojā</s> occurs. The <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Saṃmukha</s> occurs at midday. The <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Santata</s> occurs at sunset. At night, when the sun has just set, the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Bhrgo Deva</s> occurs. At midnight the <s>muhūrta</s> <s>Abhijit</s> occurs. At the end of the night the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Ātapāgni</s> occurs.

body.text:
p.107.1/.mārgaśīrṣe māse ca pūrṇe catur^daśa^muhūrte divase sūrya^udaye caturojā evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/ viratasya saṃmukhasya ca muhūrtasya^antare madhyāhno bhavati/ sūrya^avatāre varuṇo nāma muhūrto bhavati/ ṣoḍaśa^muhūrtāyāṃ rātrāv avatīrṇamātre sūrye saṃtāpanaḥ saṃyamo nāma muhūrto bhavati/ rākṣasasyābhijitasya ca muhūrtasya^antare +ardha^rātraṃ
bhavati/ rātryavasāne ātapāgnir evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/
body.translated_text: In the full month of <s>Mārgaśīrṣa</s>, with fourteen <s>muhūrtas</s> in the day, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Caturojā</s> occurs. Midday occurs in the interval between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Virata</s> and <s>Saṃmukha</s>. At sunset the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Varuṇa</s> occurs. In the night of sixteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, when the sun has just set, the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Saṃtāpana Saṃyama</s> occurs. Midnight occurs in the interval between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Rākṣasa</s> and <s>Abhijit</s>. At the end of the night the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Ātapāgni</s> occurs.

body.text: p.107.2/.pauṣamāse pūrṇe trayodaśa^muhūrte divase sūrya^udaye caturojā evaṃ nama muhūrto bhavati/ madhyāhne virato nāma muhūrto bhavati/ sūryāvatāre nairṛto nāma muhūrto bhavati/ saptadaśa^muhūrtāyāṃ rātrāv avatīrṇamātre sūrye varuṇo nāma muhūrto bhavati/ ardha^rātre rākṣaso nāma muhūrto bhavti/ rātryavasāne ātapāgnir evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/
body.translated_text: In the full month of <s>Pauṣa</s>, with thirteen <s>muhūrtas</s> in the day, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Caturojā</s> occurs. At midday the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Virata</s> occurs. At sunset the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Nairṛta</s> occurs. In the night of seventeen <s>muhūrtas</s>, when the sun has just set, the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Varuṇa</s> occurs. At midnight the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Rākṣasa</s> occurs. At the end of the night the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Ātapāgni</s> occurs.

body.text:
p.107.3/.māgha^māse pūrṇe dvādaśa^muhūrte divase sūrya^udaye caturojā nāma muhūrto bhavati/ sāvitrasya ca viratasya ca muhūrtasya^antareṇa madhyāhno bhavati/ sūryāvatāre vijayo nāma muhūrto bhavati/ aṣṭādaśa^muhūrtāyāṃ rātrāv avatīrṇamātre sūrye nairṛto nāma muhūrto bhavati/ gardabhasya muhūrtasya ca rākṣasasya ca^antaram ardha^rātraṃ bhavati/ rātryavasāna
ātapāgnir evaṃ nāma muhūrto bhavati/
body.translated_text: In the full month of <s>Māgha</s>, with twelve <s>muhūrtas</s> in the day, at sunrise the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Caturojā</s> occurs. Midday occurs in the interval between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Sāvitra</s> and <s>Virata</s>. At sunset the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Vijaya</s> occurs. In the night of eighteen <s>muhūrtas</s>, when the sun has just set, the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Nairṛta</s> occurs. Midnight occurs in the interval between the <s>muhūrtas</s> <s>Gardabha</s> and <s>Rākṣasa</s>. At the end of the night the <s>muhūrta</s> called <s>Ātapāgni</s> occurs.

body.text: p.108.1/.yathā śrāvaṇe tathā māghe/ yathā bhādrapade tathā phālgune/ yathā +asvayuje tathā caitra/ yathā kārttike tathā vaiśākhe/ yathā mārgaśīrṣe tathā jyaiṣṭhe/ yathā pauṣe tathā +aṣāḍhe/ evam eteṣāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ muhūrtānāṃ caritaṃ vicaritaṃ ca jñātavyaṃ/ nakṣatra^vicaraṇaṃ nāma prathamo +adhyāyāḥ/
body.translated_text: As in <s>Śrāvaṇa</s>, so in <s>Māgha</s>. As in <s>Bhādrapada</s>, so in <s>Phālguna</s>. As in <s>Aśvayuja</s>, so in <s>Caitra</s>. As in <s>Kārttika</s>, so in <s>Vaiśākha</s>. As in <s>Mārgaśīrṣa</s>, so in <s>Jyaiṣṭha</s>. As in <s>Pauṣa</s>, so in <s>Āṣāḍha</s>. Thus the course and movement of these <s>nakṣatras</s> (lunar mansions) and <s>muhūrtas</s> should be known. This is the first chapter, called 'The Movement of the <s>Nakṣatras</s>.'

body.text: p.108.2/.yathāmadhyaṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ rātrivaśena divasavaśena ca^utkarṣāpakarṣau kartavyau/ hīyamāne vardhamāne vā divase vā māse vā pūrṇe +ardha^māse vā/ dvitīyā ṣaṣṭhī navamī dvādaśī caturdaśī atra^antare divase kalā vardhate rātrau kalā hīyate/
body.translated_text: According to the middle [position] of the <s>nakṣatras</s>, by the dominance of night and the dominance of day, the increase and decrease should be calculated — whether the day or the month is waning or waxing, in a full or half month. On the second, sixth, ninth, twelfth, and fourteenth [days], in the interval between these days, the [day's] portion increases and the night's portion decreases.

body.text: % bhūmi^kampa^nirdeśaḥ
body.translated_text: Section on Earthquakes

body.text: p.108.3ab/.catvāro mahā^rājāno dhriyate yair vasundharā/
body.translated_text: Four great kings support the earth:

body.text: p.108.3cd/.ativṛddhir viśuddhaś ca vardhamānaḥ pṛthakśravāḥ//
body.translated_text: <s>Ativṛddhi</s>, <s>Viśuddha</s>, <s>Vardhamāna</s>, and <s>Pṛthakśravas</s>.

body.text: p.108.4ab/.mahā^bhūtāni catvāri kampayanti vasundharāṃ/
body.translated_text: Four great elements cause the earth to tremble:

body.text: p.108.4cd/.āpo indraś ca vāyuś ca tathāgnir bhagavān api//
body.translated_text: Water, <s>Indra</s>, Wind, and also Fire, and the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One).

body.text: p.108.5ab/.trayas tu te yatra bhavanti pakṣe ṣaḍeka^māse tu bhavanti vegāḥ/
body.translated_text: Three [earthquakes] occur in a fortnight, and six tremors occur in a month;

body.text: p.108.5cd/.parasya cakrasya nidarśanaṃ syāt prakampate yatra mahī tv abhīkṣṇaṃ//
body.translated_text: this would be a sign of an enemy's attack — wherever the earth trembles repeatedly.

body.text: p.109.1ab/.viśākhā daśa^rātrī ayāj jyeṣṭhā dvādaśa^rātrikā/
body.translated_text: Under <s>Viśākhā</s>, ten nights; under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, twelve nights;

body.text: p.109.1cd/.pañca^viṃśatir āṣāḍhā śravaṇā pañca^saptatiḥ//
body.translated_text: under <s>Āṣāḍhā</s>, twenty-five; under <s>Śravaṇā</s>, seventy-five.

body.text: p.109.2ab/.rātriśataṃ bhādrapade kratur aśvayuje smṛtaḥ/
body.translated_text: In <s>Bhādrapada</s>, a hundred nights; in <s>Aśvayuja</s>, the sacrifice is remembered.

body.text: p.109.2cd/.adhyardhaṃ tu pañca^pañcāśan māghe rātriśataṃ smṛtaṃ/
body.translated_text: One and a half times fifty-five; in <s>Māgha</s>, a hundred nights is recorded.

body.text: p.109.3ab/.ardhyardhaṃ phālgune māse caitre triṃśat tu rātrayaḥ/
body.translated_text: One and a half [times something] in <s>Phālguna</s> month; in <s>Caitra</s>, thirty nights.

body.text: p.109.3cd/.vipāko bhūmi^vegānām ataḥ kampaḥ pravartate//
body.translated_text: This is the ripening of earth-tremors; from this, earthquakes proceed.

body.text: p.109.4ab/.yadā sarveṣu māseṣu satataṃ kampate mahī/
body.translated_text: When in all months the earth trembles constantly,

body.text:
p.109.4cd/.vṛkṣās tathā calanti sma jalaṃ vā yadi kampate/
p.109.4ef/.parvataḥ parṇavat kamped bhayam atra vinirdiśet//
body.translated_text: and when trees also shake, or when water trembles, or when a mountain shakes like a leaf — in that case danger should be predicted.

body.text: p.110.1ab/.nagarāṇy atha vā grāmā ghoṣā ye ca^atra saṃśritāḥ/
body.translated_text: Cities and villages, and settlements that are located there,

body.text: p.110.1cd/.śīghraṃ bhavanti vijanāraṇyabhūtā mṛgāśrayāḥ//
body.translated_text: quickly become deserted, turned into wilderness, the abode of wild animals.

body.text: p.110.2ab/.aṭavyaḥ saṃpravartante daśa varṣāṇi pañca ca/
body.translated_text: Forests spread for fifteen years;

body.text: p.110.2cd/.anāvāsā diśo vidyād bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: one should know the directions are uninhabitable, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.110.3ab/.kṛttikāsu caled bhūmir grāmeṣu nagareṣu vā/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Kṛttikā</s>, in villages or in cities,

body.text: p.110.3cd/.abhīkṣṇaṃ mucyate hy agnir dahate satṛnālayān//
body.translated_text: fire is repeatedly released and burns dwellings of grass and reeds.

body.text: p.110.4ab/.kṛṣṇāgnir aśaneḥ pātaḥ, karmārā; āhitāśrayāḥ/
body.translated_text: Black fire, the fall of thunderbolts, blacksmiths, those who maintain fires,

body.text: p.110.4cd/.āgārāś ca nivartante saṃvarteneva dhātavaḥ//
body.translated_text: and dwellings collapse, as the elements do at the universal dissolution.

body.text: p.110.5ab/.ye jātā ye ca saṃvṛddhā ye ca taṃ grāmam āśritāḥ/
body.translated_text: Those who were born there, those who grew up there, and those who took refuge in that village —

body.text: p.110.5cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.110.6ab/.rohiṇyāṃ calitā bhūmiḥ sarva^bīja^vināśanaṃ/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Rohiṇī</s>, all seeds are destroyed;

body.text: p.110.6cd/.proptaṃ śasyaṃ na roheta bhavet phalasya kṛcchratā//
body.translated_text: sown grain does not grow, and there is scarcity of fruit.

body.text: p.111.1ab/.gurviṇīnāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ garbho nipīḍyate bhṛśaṃ/
body.translated_text: And the wombs of pregnant women are severely oppressed;

body.text: p.111.1cd/.durbhikṣa^vyasanākrāntā tribhāge tiṣṭhati prajā//
body.translated_text: afflicted by famine and calamity, two-thirds of the people perish.

body.text: p.111.2ab/.mahā^ātmānaś ca rājānaḥ śrīmantaś ca narottamāḥ/
body.translated_text: Great kings and prosperous, excellent men —

body.text: p.111.2cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.111.3ab/.mṛgaśīrṣe caled bhūmir oṣadhīnāṃ vināśanaṃ/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Mṛgaśīrṣa</s>, there is destruction of herbs.

body.text: p.111.3cd/.cikitsakāḥ śrotriyāś ca ghaṭakāḥ soma^yājakāḥ//
body.translated_text: Physicians, learned brahmins, makers of pots, and those who sacrifice with <s>Soma</s>,

body.text: p.111.4ab/.soma^pītāś ca ye viprā vānaprasthāś ca tāpasāḥ/
body.translated_text: <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> who have drunk <s>Soma</s>, forest-dwellers, and ascetics —

body.text: p.111.4cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.111.5ab/.ārdrāyāṃ calitā bhūmir vṛkṣā naśyanti kṣīriṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Ārdrā</s>, milk-bearing trees perish;

body.text: p.111.5cd/.anna^pānāni naśyanti pathikā daṃṣṭripālikāḥ//
body.translated_text: food and drink perish, [as do] travelers and keepers of fanged animals.

body.text: p.111.6ab/.kūpakhāḥ parikhākhāś ca pāpakā ye ca taskarāḥ/
body.translated_text: Well-diggers, moat-diggers, and wicked ones and thieves —

body.text: p.111.6cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.111.7ab/.punarvasau caled bhūmir maṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍikā^api ca/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Punarvasu</s>, territories and vessels [are affected],

body.text: p.111.7cd/.vāgurikāḥ kāraṇḍavāś cakriṇaḥ śuka^sārikāḥ//
body.translated_text: hunters with nets, <s>Kāraṇḍava</s> ducks, peacocks, parrots, and <s>sārikā</s> birds,

body.text: p.111.8ab/.arbhakā bhramakārāś ca māṃsikāḥ śaṅkhavāṇijāḥ/
body.translated_text: children, conjurers, butchers, and conch-shell merchants —

body.text: p.111.8cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.112.1ab/.puṣyeṇa ca caled bhūmir brāhmaṇā nāyakās tathā/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Puṣya</s>, <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> and leaders,

body.text: p.112.1cd/.duraṅgamā vāṇijakāḥ sārthavāhāś ca ye narāḥ//
body.translated_text: far-traveling merchants and caravan leaders,

body.text: p.112.2ab/.pārthivāḥ pārvatīyāś ca ye ca tad bhaktigocarāḥ/
body.translated_text: kings, mountain-dwellers, and those devoted to them —

body.text: p.112.2cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ/
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.112.2ef/.śilāvarṣaṃ pravarṣanti śasyānāmanayo mahān//
body.translated_text: Stones rain down, and there is great disease of crops.

body.text: p.112.3ab/.aśleṣāyāṃ caled bhūmir nāgāḥ sarve sarīsṛpāḥ/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Āśleṣā</s>, all <s>Nāgas</s> (serpent-beings) and reptiles,

body.text: p.112.3cd/.kīṭāḥ pipīlikāḥ śvānā; eka^khurāś ca ye mṛgāḥ//
body.translated_text: insects, ants, dogs, and single-hoofed animals —

body.text: p.112.4ab/.vaidyā visakarāś ca^api ye ca satvā darīśrayāḥ/
body.translated_text: physicians, poison-makers, and creatures dwelling in caves —

body.text: p.112.4cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.112.5ab/.maghāsu calitā bhūmir mahā^rājo +atra tapyate/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Maghā</s>, a great king is afflicted.

body.text: p.112.5cd/.ye ca śrāddhā nivartante samājā; utsavās tathā/
body.translated_text: <s>Śrāddha</s> (ancestral rites) cease, as do assemblies and festivals;

body.text: p.112.5ef/.yajñāś ca deva^kṛtyaṃ ca sarvam atra nivartate//
body.translated_text: sacrifices and worship of the gods — all these cease.

body.text: p.112.6ab/.ye jātā ye ca saṃvṛddhā ye ca^anye +apy agrapaṇḍitāḥ/
body.translated_text: Those who were born there, those who grew up there, and other chief scholars,

body.text: p.112.6cd/.gandharvāś ca vinaśyanti narā ye ca mahā^kulāḥ/
body.translated_text: <s>Gandharvas</s> (celestial musicians) perish, as do men of great families —

body.text: p.112.6ef/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.112.7ab/.phalgunyāṃ calitā bhūmir ṛtur vyāvartate tadā/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Phalgunī</s>, the season is disrupted;

body.text: p.112.7cd/.triyagvātaś ca^eva vāti kṛtaṃ naśyati śāśvataṃ/
body.translated_text: a crosswise wind blows, and what was established perishes permanently.

body.text: p.112.7ef/.pathikāś ca^upatapyanti māṣayācyopajīvikāḥ//
body.translated_text: Travelers are afflicted, as are those who live by begging for beans.

body.text: p.113.1ab/.dharme ratā; āsanikā ye ca śulkopajīvinaḥ/
body.translated_text: Those devoted to <s>dharma</s>, cloth-merchants, and those who live by collecting tolls —

body.text: p.113.1cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.113.2ab/.calaty uttaraphalgunyāṃ vaṇijā dvīpayātrikāḥ/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Uttaraphalgunī</s>, merchants and island-voyagers,

body.text: p.113.2cd/.sārthavāhā; āsanikā ye ca śilpopajīvinaḥ//
body.translated_text: caravan-leaders, cloth-merchants, and those who live by crafts,

body.text: p.113.3ab/.aṅgāvidehamagadhā nairṛtāḥ strī^parigrahāḥ/
body.translated_text: the people of <s>Aṅga</s>, <s>Videha</s>, <s>Magadha</s>, the south-westerners, and those with wives —

body.text: p.113.3cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.113.4ab/.hastena calitā bhūmiḥ kumbha^kāra cikitsakāḥ/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Hasta</s>, potters and physicians,

body.text: p.113.4cd/.gaṇamukhyā mahā^mātrāḥ senādhyakṣāś ca ye narāḥ//
body.translated_text: leaders of guilds, great ministers, and army commanders,

body.text: p.113.5ab/.tāramakā (?) nārapaṭā (?) vipsaraḥ (?) kauṭikā; api/
body.translated_text: star-readers (?), cloth-merchants (?), dancers (?), and tricksters —

body.text: p.113.5cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.113.6ab/.citrāyāṃ calitā bhūmiḥ kārukā; upakalpakāḥ/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Citrā</s>, artisans and attendants,

body.text: p.113.6cd/.kumāryaḥ sarva^ratnaṃ ca sasyānāṃ bīja^kaiḥ saha//
body.translated_text: maidens, all gems, and crops together with seeds,

body.text: p.113.7ab/.vaṅgā daśārṇakuravaś cedimāhiṣakās tathā/
body.translated_text: the people of <s>Vaṅga</s>, <s>Daśārṇa</s>, <s>Kuru</s>, <s>Cedi</s>, and <s>Māhiṣaka</s> —

body.text: p.113.7cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.113.8ab/.svātau pracalitā bhūmiś caurā ye ca kuśīlakāḥ/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Svāti</s>, thieves and those of bad conduct,

body.text: p.113.8cd/.hiṃsakā ye ca tat karma^ratā +abhyarthitamūṣakāḥ//
body.translated_text: the violent and those devoted to such deeds, and those who seek out stolen goods —

body.text: p.113.9ab/.himavata; uttareṇa vāyubhakṣās tapasvinaḥ/
body.translated_text: north of the <s>Himavat</s>, wind-eating ascetics —

body.text: p.113.9cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.114.1ab/.viśākhāyāṃ caled bhūmir mahā^śaila^kṣayo bhavet/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Viśākhā</s>, there would be destruction of great mountains;

body.text: p.114.1cd/.ugrā vātāḥ pravānty atra; aśmakairakuśalinaḥ//
body.translated_text: fierce winds blow, and stone-workers and those of <s>Kuśala</s> [are affected].

body.text: p.114.2ab/.anurādhe caled bhūmir dasyūnām anayo mahān/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Anurādhā</s>, there is great calamity for bandits;

body.text: p.114.2cd/.viṭā dyūta^karāś ca^eva granthibhedāś ca ye narāḥ//
body.translated_text: courtesans, gamblers, and those who break into sealed [goods],

body.text: p.114.3ab/.andhrāḥ puṇḍrāḥ pulindāś ca bhaye tiṣṭhanty anāśritāḥ//
body.translated_text: the <s>Andhras</s>, <s>Puṇḍras</s>, and <s>Pulindas</s> stand in fear without refuge,

body.text: p.114.3cd/.mitrabhedaś ca balavān tadā jagati jāyate//
body.translated_text: and a powerful rift among allies then arises in the world.

body.text: p.114.4ab/.jyeṣṭhāyāṃ calitā bhūmir mahā^rājaḥ pratapyate/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, a great king is afflicted;

body.text: p.114.4cd/.vāyasā vṛṣabhā vyāḍās tathā caṇḍamṛgāś ca ye//
body.translated_text: crows, bulls, wild beasts, and fierce animals,

body.text: p.114.5ab/.kuravaḥ śūrasenāś ca mallā bāhlīkanigrahāḥ/
body.translated_text: the <s>Kurus</s>, <s>Śūrasenas</s>, <s>Mallas</s>, and those who subdue the <s>Bāhlīkas</s>,

body.text: p.114.5cd/.pratyarthikena śīghreṇa ye ca tad bhaktibhājanāḥ/
body.translated_text: and those swiftly opposed, and those devoted to them —

body.text: p.114.5ef/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.114.6ab/.mūlena calitā bhūmiś catuṣpaddvipadās tathā/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Mūla</s>, four-footed and two-footed creatures,

body.text: p.114.6cd/.grahāśrayāḥ piśācāś ca ye ca sattvā darīśrayāḥ/
body.translated_text: those possessed by planets, <s>Piśācas</s> (demons), and creatures dwelling in caves —

body.text: p.114.6ef/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.115.1ab/.durbhikṣaṃ ca karoty āśu dhānyam alpa^udakaṃ bhavet/
body.translated_text: It quickly causes famine; grain becomes scarce in water;

body.text: p.115.1cd/.darīparvatamūlāni gacchanti ca tadā bhuvi//
body.translated_text: at that time [creatures] go to caves, mountain bases, and the ground.

body.text: p.115.2ab/.pūrvāṣāḍhe caled bhūmir jalajā matsya^śuktikāḥ/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s>, aquatic creatures, fish, and shellfish,

body.text: p.115.2cd/.śiśumārā; udrakāś ca nakrā makara^kacchapāḥ//
body.translated_text: crocodiles, otters, <s>Nakras</s> (gharials), <s>Makaras</s> (sea-monsters), and turtles,

body.text: p.115.3ab/.jātigotra^pradhānāś ca dhanino +atha vicakṣaṇāḥ/
body.translated_text: those eminent in birth and lineage, the wealthy and the discerning,

body.text: p.115.3cd/.dvitīyābhijātāś ca mahā^vidyākarāś ca ye/
body.translated_text: those of the second birth-class, and great sorcerers —

body.text: p.115.3ef/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: these meet with calamity, shaken by earthquakes.

body.text: p.115.4ab/.uttarasyāṃ caled bhūmiḥ śilpinām anayo mahān/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles under <s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s>, there is great calamity for craftsmen;

body.text: p.115.4cd/.ayaskārāḥ sthāpatayas trapu^kārāś ca takṣakāḥ//
body.translated_text: iron-workers, architects, tin-workers, and carpenters.

body.text: p.115.5ab/.daridrā dhaninaś ca^api śilpino vividhā; api/
body.translated_text: The poor as well as the rich, and artisans of various kinds,

body.text: p.115.5cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ/
body.translated_text: they meet with calamity, shaken by the trembling of the earth,

body.text: p.115.5ef/.grāma^kuṭāni ca ghnanti sacalasthāvarāṇi ca//
body.translated_text: and it destroys village dwellings and both moving and stationary beings.

body.text: p.115.6ab/.vaiṣṇave calitā bhūmis tadeti yad anīpsitaṃ/
body.translated_text: When the earth trembles in [the <s>nakṣatra</s>] <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> (Śravaṇā), that which is unwanted comes to pass.

body.text: p.116.1ab/.adhyāpakāḥ śāstra^vidaḥ kavayo mantra^pāragāḥ/
body.translated_text: Teachers, those learned in the <s>śāstras</s>, poets, masters of <s>mantras</s>,

body.text: p.116.1cd/.yugandharāḥ śūrasenā; abhirājāḥ paṭaccarāḥ//
body.translated_text: the <s>Yugandharas</s>, the <s>Śūrasenas</s>, the <s>Abhirājas</s>, the <s>Paṭaccaras</s>,

body.text: p.116.2ab/.kuśaṇḍāḥ śaradaṇḍāś ca ye narā rāja^pūjitāḥ/
body.translated_text: the <s>Kuśaṇḍas</s> and the <s>Śaradaṇḍas</s>, and whatever men are honored by the king —

body.text: p.116.2cd/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: they all meet with calamity, shaken by the trembling of the earth.

body.text: p.116.3ab/.dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ caled bhūmir dhaninā manayo mahān/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles in <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>, there is great calamity for the wealthy;

body.text: p.116.3cd/.maheśvarās tathā mahā^nāgarāḥ śreṣṭhinas tathā//
body.translated_text: likewise the great lords, the great citizens, and the chief merchants,

body.text: p.116.4ab/.pracaṇḍāḥ svastimantaś ca bhadrakārā yugandharāḥ/
body.translated_text: the fierce, the prosperous, the auspicious, the <s>Yugandharas</s>,

body.text: p.116.4cd/.pārikūlāś ca bhojyāś ca hy anye sannāgarā; api/
body.translated_text: the adversaries, the <s>Bhojyas</s>, and others who are city-dwellers —

body.text: p.116.4ef/.ete vyasanam arcchanti bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: they all meet with calamity, shaken by the trembling of the earth.

body.text: p.116.5ab/.vāruṇye calitā bhūmir audakeṣv anayo mahān/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles in <s>Vāruṇya</s> (Śatabhiṣaj), there is great calamity for those connected with water;

body.text: p.116.5cd/.hastino +aśvakharoṣṭrāś ca sparśam arcchanti dāruṇaṃ//
body.translated_text: elephants, horses, donkeys, and camels suffer terrible affliction.

body.text: p.116.6ab/.tadāsau vīrakān madrān bāhlīkān kekayān api/
body.translated_text: Then it would oppress the <s>Vīrakas</s>, the <s>Madras</s>, the <s>Bāhlīkas</s>, and the <s>Kekayas</s>,

body.text: p.116.6cd/.anāśrayāṃś cakravākāñ janasthān api pīḍayet//
body.translated_text: the homeless, the <s>Cakravākas</s>, and also the people of <s>Janasthāna</s>.

body.text: p.117.1ab/.sājena calitā bhūmī rākṣasān ghātakāṃs tathā/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles in [the <s>nakṣatra</s>] <s>Sāja</s> (Pūrvabhādrapadā), it would cast down the <s>Rākṣasas</s>, the slaughterers,

body.text: p.117.1cd/.aurabhrikān saukarikān sauvīrāṃś ca nipātayet//
body.translated_text: the sheep-dealers, the pig-keepers, and the <s>Sauvīras</s>.

body.text: p.117.2ab/.vaṇijyajīvino vaiśyān śūdrāṃś ca karītīn api/
body.translated_text: It destroys the <s>Vaiśyas</s> who live by trade, the <s>Śūdras</s> and hired workers,

body.text: p.117.2cd/.yavanān mālavādyāṃś ca granthibhedāṃś ca nāśayet//
body.translated_text: the <s>Yavanas</s> (Greeks), the <s>Mālavas</s> and others, and the pickpockets.

body.text: p.117.3ab/.ahirbudhnye caled bhūmir vaṇijām anayo mahān/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles in <s>Ahirbudhnya</s> (Uttarabhādrapadā), there is great calamity for traders;

body.text: p.117.3cd/.dharme ratāś ca ye siddhā ye ca śauktikakarmiṇaḥ//
body.translated_text: those devoted to <s>dharma</s> and the accomplished ones, and those who work with shells and pearls,

body.text: p.117.4ab/.śibīn vatsān tathā vātsyān kṣatriyān ārjunāyanān/
body.translated_text: the <s>Śibis</s>, the <s>Vatsas</s>, likewise the <s>Vātsyas</s>, the <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, the <s>Ārjunāyanas</s>,

body.text: p.117.4cd/.sindhurāja^dhanuṣpānīn sarvān ardayate +acirāt//
body.translated_text: the king of <s>Sindhu</s>, the [people of] <s>Dhanuṣpānī</s> — it afflicts them all before long.

body.text: p.117.5ab/.revatyāṃ calitā bhūmiḥ saṃgrāmaḥ syāt sudāruṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles in <s>Revatī</s>, there will be a most terrible battle;

body.text: p.117.5cd/.grāma^ghātāś ca vartante grāmo grāmaṃ ca hiṃsati//
body.translated_text: slaughters of villages occur, and village attacks village.

body.text: p.117.6ab/.naucarān udakājīvān ramaṭhān bharukacchakān/
body.translated_text: Sailors, those who live by water, the <s>Ramaṭhas</s>, the people of <s>Bharukaccha</s> (Broach),

body.text: p.117.6cd/.sudhanvān abhisārāṃś ca sarva^senāṃś ca nirdahet//
body.translated_text: the <s>Sudhanvans</s>, the <s>Abhisāras</s>, and all the armies — it would burn them all.

body.text: p.118.1ab/.aśvinyāṃ calitā bhūmir aśvānām anayo mahān/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles in <s>Aśvinī</s>, there is great calamity for horses;

body.text: p.118.1cd/.grāma^ghātāś ca vartante bhrātā bhrātṝn jighāṃsati//
body.translated_text: slaughters of villages occur, and brother seeks to kill brother.

body.text: p.118.2ab/.yā ca^atra gabham ādhatte ye ca jātāś ca tān iha/
body.translated_text: Whoever conceives a child therein and those who are born then —

body.text: p.118.2cd/.trīṇi varṣāṇy ato duḥkham upaiti ca nirantaraṃ//
body.translated_text: suffering befalls them continuously for three years.

body.text: p.118.3ab/.sahitāś citra^garbhāś ca ye hy anye ca^aṅganājanāḥ/
body.translated_text: The <s>Sahitas</s>, the <s>Citragarbhas</s>, and other people of the <s>Aṅga</s> realm,

body.text: p.118.3cd/.ārjunāyanā rājanyāḥ suṣṭhu trīṃś ca^api hiṃsati//
body.translated_text: the <s>Ārjunāyanas</s> and royal ones — it greatly harms these three as well.

body.text: p.118.4ab/.bharaṇyāṃ calitā bhūmiś caurāṇām anayo mahān/
body.translated_text: If the earth trembles in <s>Bharaṇī</s>, there is great calamity for thieves;

body.text: p.118.4cd/.viṭā dyūta^karāś ca^eva granthibhedāś ca ye narāḥ//
body.translated_text: rogues, gamblers, pickpockets,

body.text: p.118.5ab/.ādarśacakrāṭādhūrtās tathā bandhana^rakṣakāḥ/
body.translated_text: mirror-tricksters, cheats, and prison guards,

body.text: p.118.5cd/.antāvaśāyinaḥ pāpāś caranti ye tu durjanāḥ/
body.translated_text: sinful border-dwellers and those wicked persons who roam about —

body.text: p.118.5ef/.te +api tatra vipadyante bhūmi^cālavicālitāḥ//
body.translated_text: they too perish there, shaken by the trembling of the earth.

body.text: p.118.6ab/.vepitāyāṃ tu medinyāṃ bhaved rūpam anantaraṃ/
body.translated_text: When the earth trembles, the following sign appears immediately:

body.text: p.118.6cd/.saptāhābhyantarāt tatra megho bhavati prārthitaḥ//
body.translated_text: within seven days, a longed-for cloud appears.

body.text: p.119.1ab/.snigdho hy aṅjana^saṃkāśo mahā^parvatasannibhaḥ/
body.translated_text: Smooth, resembling <s>añjana</s> (collyrium), like a great mountain,

body.text: p.119.1cd/.indraś na varṣate tatra maharṣer vacanaṃ yathā//
body.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> does not rain there, as the great sage has said.

body.text: p.119.1ef/.[evaṃ nigaditaṃ nārthair indraś ca^atra pravarṣati//]
body.translated_text: [Thus it has been declared by these [signs]; and <s>Indra</s> rains therein.]

body.text: p.119.2ab/.svastikā kāra^saṃkāśā; indravajradhvayopamāḥ/
body.translated_text: Clouds shaped like <s>svastika</s> signs, resembling double <s>Indra</s>-thunderbolts,

body.text: p.119.2cd/.dṛśyante +abhrā hi sandhyāyāṃ grastvā candra^divā^karau//
body.translated_text: are seen at twilight, swallowing the moon and the sun.

body.text: p.119.3ab/.tadā nabhasi jāyante meghā ḍāḍimbasannibhāḥ/
body.translated_text: Then clouds resembling pomegranates arise in the sky;

body.text: p.119.3cd/.lakṣaṇaṃ tādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyāt tānn indrakampitān/
body.translated_text: seeing such a sign, one should know them as <s>Indra</s>-caused earthquakes.

body.text: p.119.3ef/.sa nirdeśo bhavet tatra maharṣer vacanaṃ yathā//
body.translated_text: That is the indication, as the great sage has said.

body.text: p.119.4ab/.atīva tatra viśvastaḥ sarva^bījāni vāpayet/
body.translated_text: With full confidence therein, one should sow all seeds;

body.text: p.119.4cd/.vyavahārāṃś ca kurvīran nirbhayās tatra vāṇijāḥ/
body.translated_text: and merchants should conduct their trade fearlessly.

body.text: p.119.4ef/.sarveṣāṃ bhūmi^kampānāṃ praśastā; indrakaṃpitāḥ//
body.translated_text: Of all earthquakes, the <s>Indra</s>-caused ones are the most auspicious.

body.text: p.119.5ab/.vepitāyāṃ tu medinyāṃ bhaved rūpam anantaraṃ/
body.translated_text: When the earth trembles, the following sign appears immediately:

body.text: p.119.5cd/.saptāhābhyantare tatra meghaḥ saṃcchādayen nabhaḥ//
body.translated_text: within seven days, a cloud covers the sky.

body.text: p.120.1ab/.tato +anubaddhā jāyante; abhrāḥ kauśeyasannibhāḥ/
body.translated_text: Then clouds appear in succession, resembling silk garments;

body.text: p.120.1cd/.anulomaṃ ca saṃyānti carantaḥ paścimāṃ diśaṃ//
body.translated_text: they move in a favorable direction, traveling toward the west.

body.text: p.120.2ab/.śiśumāra^udrakāṇāṃ matsya^makara^sannibhāḥ/
body.translated_text: Resembling porpoises, otters, fish, and <s>makara</s> (sea-creatures),

body.text: p.120.2cd/.dṛśyante +abhrāś ca sandhyāyāṃ grastvā candra^divā^karau//
body.translated_text: clouds are seen at twilight, swallowing the moon and the sun.

body.text: p.120.3ab/.lakṣaṇaṃ tādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyāt tāñ jalakampitān/
body.translated_text: Seeing such a sign, one should know them as water-caused earthquakes.

body.text: p.120.3cd/.sa nirdeśo bhavet tatra maharṣer vacanaṃ yathā//
body.translated_text: That is the indication, as the great sage has said.

body.text: p.120.4ab/.sthāleṣu giri^kūṭeṣu kṣetreṣūpavaneṣu ca/
body.translated_text: On elevated ground, mountain peaks, fields, and gardens,

body.text: p.120.4cd/.sthāpyante tatra bījāni nimne naśyanti vai tadā//
body.translated_text: seeds should be planted there; in low-lying areas they perish then.

body.text: p.120.5ab/.pañkeṇa^api jalena^api naśyeyū rajasā^api vā/
body.translated_text: They may be destroyed by mud, by water, or by dust.

body.text: p.120.5cd/.eteṣāṃ bhūmi^kampānāṃ praśastā jalakampitāḥ//
body.translated_text: Of all earthquakes, the water-caused ones are [moderately] auspicious.

body.text: p.120.6ab/.vepitāyāṃ tu medinyāṃ bhaved rūpam anantaraṃ/
body.translated_text: When the earth trembles, the following sign appears immediately:

body.text: p.120.6cd/.saptāhābhyantare tatra vātā vānti sudāruṇāḥ//
body.translated_text: within seven days, most terrible winds blow.

body.text: p.120.7ab/.dṛśyate kapilā sandhyā candra^sūryau tu lohitāu/
body.translated_text: A tawny twilight is seen, and the moon and sun appear reddish;

body.text: p.120.7cd/.lakṣaṇaṃ tādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā jānīyād vāyukampitān//
body.translated_text: seeing such a sign, one should know them as wind-caused earthquakes.

body.text: p.121.1ab/.tato bhavati nirdeśo maharṣer vacanaṃ yathā/
body.translated_text: Then the indication comes, as the great sage has said:

body.text: p.121.1cd/.na tatra pravaset prājña; ātmānaṃ ca^atra gopayet//
body.translated_text: the wise one should not travel; he should protect himself.

body.text: p.121.2ab/.guhyam āvaraṇaṃ kuryāt prākāraparikhāṃ khanet/
body.translated_text: He should make a secret shelter, dig a rampart and a moat;

body.text: p.121.2cd/.prātisīmā virudhyante narāṇāṃ jāyate bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: border disputes arise, and fear befalls people.

body.text: p.121.3ab/.eteṣāṃ bhūmi^kampanaṃ sarveṣāṃ kīrtitā guṇāḥ/
body.translated_text: Of all the earthquakes, the qualities have been declared;

body.text: p.121.3cd/.viśeṣeṇa manuṣyāṇāṃ nirmitā vāyukampitāḥ//
body.translated_text: especially for humans, the wind-caused earthquakes are most dire.

body.text: p.121.4ab/.kampitāyāṃ tu medinyāṃ bhaved rūpam anantaraṃ/
body.translated_text: When the earth trembles, the following sign appears immediately:

body.text: p.121.4cd/.saptāhābhyantarāt tatra; ulkā^pātāḥ sudāruṇāḥ//
body.translated_text: within seven days, most terrible meteors fall.

body.text: p.121.5ab/.sandhyā ca lohitā bhāti candra^sūryau tu lohitau/
body.translated_text: The twilight glows red, and the moon and sun appear reddish;

body.text: p.121.5cd/.lakṣaṇaṃ tādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā vijñeyā; agnikampitāḥ//
body.translated_text: seeing such a sign, one should know them as fire-caused earthquakes.

body.text: p.121.6ab/.agnir dahati kāṣṭhāni rakṣitāni dhanāni ca/
body.translated_text: Fire burns timber and stored wealth;

body.text: p.121.6cd/.dṛśyante dhūmaśikharāḥ śastraṃ ca svidyate bhṛśaṃ//
body.translated_text: columns of smoke are seen, and weapons sweat profusely.

body.text: p.121.7ab/.vīṇāś ca divi dṛśyante navamāsān na varṣati/
body.translated_text: Lutes (vīṇās) are seen in the sky; for nine months there is no rain.

body.text: p.121.7cd/.eteṣāṃ bhūmi^kampānāṃ jaghanyā; agnikampitāḥ//
body.translated_text: Of all earthquakes, the fire-caused ones are the worst.

body.text:
p.121.8a/.jayati; ahani pūrve kṣatriyān pārthivāṃś ca/
p.121.8b/.haya^gaja^ratha^mukhyān mantriṇo madhyama^ahne/
body.translated_text: In the first part of the day, it conquers <s>Kṣatriyas</s> and kings; in the middle of the day, those foremost in horses, elephants, and chariots, and the ministers;

body.text: p.122.1ab/.vyathayati; āpara^ahṇe gopaśūn vaiśya^śūdrān/
body.translated_text: in the afternoon, it afflicts cowherds, <s>Śūdras</s>, <s>Vaiśyas</s>, and servants;

body.text: p.122.1cd/.pradahati niśi^sandhyā taskara^ananta^vāsān//
body.translated_text: at the evening twilight, it burns thieves, serpents, and forest-dwellers.

body.text: p.122.2a/.rajanim iha pradoṣe hiṃsate mleccha^saṃghān/
body.translated_text: In the first watch of the night, it harms the hordes of <s>Mlecchas</s> (barbarians);

body.text: p.122.2b/.striyam api ca napuṃsaś ca^ardha^rātreṣv anantān/
body.translated_text: at midnight, women, eunuchs, and the countless [lowly];

body.text: p.122.2c/.kṛṣi^vaṇig upajīvyān hanti yāme tṛtīye/
body.translated_text: in the third watch, it kills those who live by agriculture and trade;

body.text: p.122.2d/.vyathayati surapakṣaṃ raudra^karma^antakṛṣṇe//
body.translated_text: in the dark [fortnight of] <s>Rudra</s>'s [constellation of] action, it afflicts the side of the gods.

body.text: p.122.3a/.pradahati śaśipakṣe yājñikaṃ brahma^kṣatraṃ/
body.translated_text: In the bright lunar fortnight, it burns the priestly and warrior classes devoted to sacrifice;

body.text: p.122.3b/.śrapayati śuci^vṛttām eva dharme pradhānān/
body.translated_text: it afflicts those of pure conduct and those foremost in <s>dharma</s>;

body.text: p.122.3c/.viduṣi ca mṛdu^bhāvaṃ vindate yo hy adhīte/
body.translated_text: but he who possesses gentleness among the learned and who studies —

body.text: p.122.3d/.sa bhavati nṛpa^pūjyo bāhmaṇo deva^darśī//
body.translated_text: that <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, honored by kings, becomes a seer of the gods.

body.text: p.123.1ab/.bṛhaspateś ca catvāri samāni śubha^karmaṇā/
body.translated_text: Four [effects] are equal to the actions of <s>Bṛhaspati</s> through auspicious deeds;

body.text: p.123.1cd/.catvāri sūrya^karmāṇi tulyāni śukra^karmaṇā/
body.translated_text: four actions of the Sun are equal to the actions of <s>Śukra</s>;

body.text: p.123.1ef/.soma^karmāṇi catvāri brahma^karma ca tatsamaṃ//
body.translated_text: four actions of <s>Soma</s> (the Moon) are equal to the actions of <s>Brahmā</s>.

body.text: p.123.2/.ayaṃ bhoḥ puṣkarasārin bhūmi^kampa^nirdeśo nāma^adhyāyaḥ/
body.translated_text: This, O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, is the chapter called "The Indication of Earthquakes."

body.text: % vyādhi^samutthānaṃ
body.translated_text: % The Arising of Diseases

body.text: p.123.3/.atha bhoḥ puṣkarasārin amīṣām aṣṭāviṃśatīnāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ roga^utpattiṃ nāma^adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāmi/ tac chrūyatāṃ/ kathayatu bhagavān/
body.translated_text: Now, O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, I shall explain the chapter called "The Arising of Diseases" for these twenty-eight <s>nakṣatras</s> (lunar mansions). Listen to it. Let the Blessed One speak.

body.text: p.123.4ab/.kṛttikāsu^utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease that arises in <s>Kṛttikā</s>, whether for a woman or a man,

body.text: p.123.4cd/.catūrātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: the disease will last four nights, and after that one is freed from it.

body.text: p.123.5ab/.agnir hi devatā tatra dadhnā hy asya baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Agni</s> (Fire) is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with curds.

body.text: p.123.5cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering rite, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.123.6ab/.rohiṇyām utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease that arises in <s>Rohiṇī</s>, whether for a woman or a man,

body.text: p.123.6cd/.pañca^rātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: the disease will last five nights, and after that one is freed from it.

body.text: p.123.7ab/.devaḥ prajāpatis tatra śuddhamālyair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: The god <s>Prajāpati</s> is [the deity] there; one should offer an oblation with pure garlands.

body.text: p.123.7cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering rite, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.123.8ab/.vyādhir mṛgaśirobhutaḥ striyo vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arisen from <s>Mṛgaśiras</s>, whether for a woman or a man,

body.text: p.123.8cd/.aṣṭa^rātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: the disease will last eight nights, and after that one is freed from it.

body.text: p.123.9ab/.somo hi devatā tatra maṇḍena tu baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Soma</s> (the Moon) is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with <s>maṇḍa</s> (rice gruel).

body.text: p.123.9cd/.anena bali^dānena tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering gift, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.124.1ab/.(124) ādrāyām utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease that arises in <s>Ārdrā</s>, whether for a woman or a man,

body.text: p.124.1cd/.daśa^rātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: the disease will last ten nights, and after that one is freed from it.

body.text: p.124.2ab/.rudro hi devatā tatra pāyasena baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Rudra</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with <s>pāyasa</s> (rice pudding).

body.text: p.124.2cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering rite, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.124.3ab/.punarvasau bhaved vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease that arises in <s>Punarvasu</s>, whether for a woman or a man,

body.text: p.124.3cd/.aṣṭa^rātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: the disease will last eight nights, and after that one is freed from it.

body.text: p.124.4ab/.ādityo devatā tatra gandha^mālyair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Āditya</s> (the Sun) is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with fragrances and garlands.

body.text: p.124.4cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering rite, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.124.5ab/.puṣye samutthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease that arises in <s>Puṣya</s>, whether for a woman or a man,

body.text: p.124.5cd/.stokakālaṃ bhavet tasya pañca^rātrād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: it will last a short time; one is freed within five nights.

body.text: p.124.6ab/.devo bṛhaspatis tatra gandha^mālyair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: The god <s>Bṛhaspati</s> is [the deity] there; one should offer an oblation with fragrances and garlands.

body.text: p.124.6cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering rite, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.124.7ab/.aśleṣāyāṃ bhaved vyādhiḥ striyo vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease that arises in <s>Aśleṣā</s>, whether for a woman or a man —

body.text: p.124.7cd/.na taṃ vaidyāś cikitsantu sarpas tatra tu daivataḥ//
body.translated_text: physicians should not treat it; the Serpent is the deity there.

body.text: p.124.8ab/.maghā^samutthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease that arises in <s>Maghā</s>, whether for a woman or a man,

body.text: p.124.8cd/.aṣṭa^rātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: the disease will last eight nights, and after that one is freed from it.

body.text:
p.124.9ab/.pitaro devatās tatra kṛsareṇa baliṃ haret/
p.124.9cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: The <s>Pitṛs</s> (Ancestors) are the deities there; one should offer an oblation with <s>kṛsara</s> (rice and sesame porridge). By this offering rite, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.124.10ab/.pūrvaphālgunījā vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arisen from <s>Pūrvaphālgunī</s>, whether for a woman or a man,

body.text: p.124.10cd/.sapta^rātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: the disease will last seven nights, and after that one is freed from it.

body.text: p.125.1ab/.(125) aryamā devatā tatra gandha^mālyair baliṃ haret/ %bhaga
body.translated_text: <s>Aryaman</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with fragrances and garlands.

body.text: p.125.1cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering rite, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.125.2ab/.uttarāyāṃ bhaved vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease that arises in <s>Uttarā[phālgunī]</s>, whether for a woman or a man,

body.text: p.125.2cd/.na taṃ vaidyāś cikitsantu bhago py atra tu devatā//%aryaman
body.translated_text: Physicians should not treat him; <s>Bhaga</s> is the deity here.

body.text: p.125.3ab/.hastenāpy utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising in the hand (<s>Hasta nakṣatra</s>), whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.125.3cd/.pañca^rātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: will last for five nights, and after that one is freed.

body.text: p.125.4ab/.ravir hi devatā tatra gandha^puṣpair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Ravi</s> (the Sun) is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with fragrant flowers.

body.text: p.125.4cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.125.5ab/.citrāyām uttthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Citrā</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.125.5cd/.aṣṭa^rātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: will last for eight nights, and after that one is freed.

body.text: p.125.6ab/.tvaṣṭā hi devatā tatra ghṛtam udgair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with ghee and songs of praise.

body.text: p.125.6cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.125.7ab/.svātyāṃ samutthito vyādiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Svāti</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.125.7cd/.kleśito hi bhaved vyādhiḥ pañca^viṃśati^rātrikaḥ//
body.translated_text: will be an afflicting disease lasting twenty-five nights.

body.text: p.125.8ab/.devatā^atra bhaved vāyuś citra^mālyair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Vāyu</s> (the Wind) is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with colorful garlands.

body.text: p.125.8cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.125.9ab/.viśākhāyāṃ bhaved vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Viśākhā</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.125.9cd/.guruko +asau bhaved vyādhir ahāny ekonaviṃśatiḥ//
body.translated_text: will be a severe disease lasting nineteen days.

body.text: p.126.1ab/.(126) indrāgnī^devate tatra gandha^mālyair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> are the deities there; one should offer an oblation with fragrant garlands.

body.text: p.126.1cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.126.2ab/.anurādhā^utthito vyādiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Anurādhā</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.126.2cd/.ardha^māsaṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: will last for half a month, and after that one is freed.

body.text: p.126.3ab/.mitro hi devatā tatra ghṛta^pātraṃ baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Mitra</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with a vessel of ghee.

body.text: p.126.3cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.126.4ab/.jyeṣṭhāyām utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.126.4cd/.kleśiko hi bhaved vyādhir ahorātra^trayodaśa//
body.translated_text: will be an afflicting disease lasting thirteen days and nights.

body.text: p.126.5ab/.indro hi devatā tatra gandha^mālyair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with fragrant garlands.

body.text: p.126.5cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.126.6ab/.mūle samutthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Mūla</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.126.6cd/.māsiko hi bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: will last for a month, and after that one is freed.

body.text: p.126.7ab/.nairṛtir devatā tatra madya^māṃsair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Nirṛti</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with liquor and meat.

body.text: p.126.7cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.126.8ab/.pūrvāṣāḍhe bhaved vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.126.8cd/.sāṃkleśiko bhaved vyādhir aṣṭau māsān na saṃśayaḥ//
body.translated_text: will be an afflicting disease lasting eight months without doubt.

body.text: p.126.9ab/.āpo hi devatās tatra kṛsareṇa baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: The Waters (<s>Āpas</s>) are the deities there; one should offer an oblation with <s>kṛsara</s> (rice and sesame porridge).

body.text: p.126.9cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.126.10ab/.uttarāyāṃ bhaved vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.126.10cd/.sapta^rātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: will last for seven nights, and after that one is freed.

body.text: p.126.11ab/.viśvo hi devatā tatra pāyasena baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Viśva</s> (the All-gods) is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with <s>pāyasa</s> (milk-rice).

body.text: p.126.11cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.127.1ab/.(127) abhijid utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Abhijit</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.127.1cd/.ṣaṇ^māsān saṃbhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: will last for six months, and after that one is freed.

body.text: p.127.2ab/.viṣṇuś ca devatā tatra dadhi^maṇḍaṃ baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with buttermilk.

body.text: p.127.2cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.127.3ab/.śravaṇena^utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Śravaṇa</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.127.3cd/.guruko hi bhaved vyādhiḥ pūrṇaṃ dvādaśa^māsikaṃ//
body.translated_text: will be a severe disease lasting a full twelve months.

body.text: p.127.4ab/.viṣṇur hi devatā tatra gandha^mālyair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with fragrant garlands.

body.text: p.127.4cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.127.5ab/.dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ bhaved vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.127.5cd/.guruko he bhaved vyādhiḥ pūrṇamāsān trayodaśa//
body.translated_text: will be a severe disease lasting a full thirteen months.

body.text: p.127.6ab/.vasavo devatās tatra ghṛta^mālyair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: The <s>Vasus</s> are the deities there; one should offer an oblation with ghee and garlands.
