body.text: p.127.6cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.127.7ab/.śatabhiṣā^utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Śatabhiṣā</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.127.7cd/.trayodaśa^divas tatra tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: will last thirteen days there, and after that one is freed.

body.text: p.127.8ab/.varuṇo devatā tatra pāyasena baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Varuṇa</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with <s>pāyasa</s> (milk-rice).

body.text: p.127.8cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.127.9ab/.pūrvabhadra^utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>, whether of a woman or a man —

body.text: p.127.9cd/.na taṃ vaidyāś cikitsantu ahirbudhnyo +atra daivataḥ//
body.translated_text: physicians should not treat it; <s>Ajaikapād</s> (Ahirbudhnya) is the deity here.

body.text: p.127.10ab/.uttarabhādrajo vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.127.10cd/.sapta^rātraṃ bhaved vyādhis tataś ca^ūrdhvaṃ vimucyate//
body.translated_text: will last for seven nights, and after that one is freed.

body.text: p.128.1ab/.(128) aryamā devatā tatra gandha^mālyair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Aryaman</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with fragrant garlands.

body.text: p.128.1cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.128.2ab/.revatyām utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Revatī</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.128.2cd/.mṛduko hi bhaved vyādhir aṣṭāviṃśati^rātrikaḥ//
body.translated_text: will be a mild disease lasting twenty-eight nights.

body.text: p.128.3ab/.pūṣā hi devatā tatra gandha^mālyair baliṃ haret/
body.translated_text: <s>Pūṣan</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with fragrant garlands.

body.text: p.128.3cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.128.4ab/.aśvinyām utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Aśvinī</s>, whether of a woman or a man,

body.text: p.128.4cd/.sāṃkleśiko bhaved vyādhiḥ pañca^viṃśati^rātrikaḥ//
body.translated_text: will be an afflicting disease lasting twenty-five nights.

body.text: p.128.5ab/.gandharvo devatā tatra yāvakena baliṃ haret/ %gandharva!
body.translated_text: The <s>Gandharva</s> is the deity there; one should offer an oblation with barley porridge.

body.text: p.128.5cd/.anena bali^karmeṇa tasmād rogād vimucyate//
body.translated_text: By this offering ritual, one is freed from that disease.

body.text: p.128.6ab/.bharaṇyām utthito vyādhiḥ striyā vā puruṣasya vā/
body.translated_text: A disease arising under <s>Bharaṇī</s>, whether of a woman or a man —

body.text: p.128.6cd/.na taṃ vaidyāś cikitsantu yamas tatra tu daivataḥ/
body.translated_text: physicians should not treat it; <s>Yama</s> is the deity here.

body.text: p.128.7ab/.śīlaṃ rakṣatu medhāvī tataḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyati//
body.translated_text: Let the wise one preserve his virtue, and from that he will go to heaven.

body.text: p.128.7cd/.ayaṃ bhoḥ puṣkarasārin vyādhi^samutthāno nāma^adhyāyaḥ/
body.translated_text: This, sir <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, is the chapter called 'The Origin of Diseases.'

body.text: % bandhana^nirmokṣaḥ
body.translated_text: [Chapter:] Liberation from Bondage

body.text: p.128.8/.atha khalu bhoḥ puṣkarasārin bandhana^nirmokṣaṃ nāma^adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmi/ tac chrūyatāṃ/ kathayatu bhagavān//
body.translated_text: Now then, sir <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, I shall explain the chapter called 'Liberation from Bondage.' Please hear it. 'Let the venerable one speak.'

body.text:
p.129.1/.kṛttikāsu bhoḥ puṣkarasārin baddho vā ruddho vā tri^rātreṇa mokṣyati^iti vaktavyaḥ/ rohiṇyāṃ baddho vā ruddho vā tri^rātreṇa mokṣyati^iti/ mṛgaśirasi baddho vā ruddho vā eka^viṃśati rātreṇa mokṣyati^iti/ ārdrāyāṃ baddho vā ruddho vā +ardha^māsena mokṣyati^iti/ punarvasau ruddho vā baddho vā sapta^rātrena/ puṣye tri^rātreṇa/ aśleṣāyāṃ triṃśad^rātreṇa/
maghāsu ṣoḍaśa^rātreṇa/ citrāyāṃ sapta^rātreṇa/ svātyāṃ daśa^rātreṇa/ viśākhāyāṃ ṣaḍviṃśad^rātreṇa/ anurādhāyām eka^triṃśad rātreṇa/ jyeṣṭhāyām aṣṭādaśa^rātreṇa/ mūle ṣaṭtriṃśad rātreṇa/ pūrvāṣāḍhāyāṃ catur^daśa^rātreṇa/ uttarāṣāḍhāyāṃ catur^daśa^rātreṇa/ abhijiti ṣaḍ^rātreṇa/ śravaṇe dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ śatabhiṣāyāṃ pūrvabhadrapade uttarabhādrapade revatyāṃ
catur^daśa^rātreṇa/ aśvinyāṃ tri^rātreṇa/ bharaṇyāṃ baddho vā ruddho vā parikleśam avāpsyati^iti vaktavyaḥ/
body.translated_text: Under <s>Kṛttikā</s>, sir <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, one who is bound or imprisoned will be freed within three nights — so it should be declared. Under <s>Rohiṇī</s>, one who is bound or imprisoned will be freed within three nights. Under <s>Mṛgaśiras</s>, one who is bound or imprisoned will be freed within twenty-one nights. Under <s>Ārdrā</s>, one who is bound or imprisoned will be freed within half a month. Under <s>Punarvasu</s>, one imprisoned or bound [will be freed] within seven nights. Under <s>Puṣya</s>, within three nights. Under <s>Āśleṣā</s>, within thirty nights. Under <s>Maghā</s>, within sixteen nights. Under <s>Citrā</s>, within seven nights. Under <s>Svāti</s>, within ten nights. Under <s>Viśākhā</s>, within twenty-six nights. Under <s>Anurādhā</s>, within thirty-one nights. Under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, within eighteen nights. Under <s>Mūla</s>, within thirty-six nights. Under <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s>, within fourteen nights. Under <s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s>, within fourteen nights. Under <s>Abhijit</s>, within six nights. Under <s>Śravaṇa</s>, <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>, <s>Śatabhiṣā</s>, <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>, <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s>, and <s>Revatī</s>, within fourteen nights. Under <s>Aśvinī</s>, within three nights. Under <s>Bharaṇī</s>, one who is bound or imprisoned will suffer affliction — so it should be declared.

body.text: p.129.2/.ayaṃ bhoḥ puṣkarasārin bandhana^nirmokṣo nāma^adhyāya/
body.translated_text: This, sir <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, is the chapter called 'Liberation from Bondage.'

body.text: % tilaka^adhyāyaḥ
body.translated_text: [Chapter:] The Chapter on Bodily Marks (<s>Tilaka</s>)

body.text: p.129.3/.atha boḥ puskarasārin tilaka^adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmi/ tac chrūyatāṃ/ kathayatu bhagavān//
body.translated_text: Now, sir <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, I shall explain the chapter on <s>Tilaka</s> (bodily marks). Please hear it. 'Let the venerable one speak.'

body.text: p.129.4/.mūrdhni tu yasyās tilako +asti sūkṣmaḥ snigdho bhavet padma^samāna^varṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: A woman who has a fine, smooth mark (<s>tilaka</s>) on the crown of her head, of lotus-like color,

body.text: p.129.5/.rājā tu tasyā bhavati^iha bhartā stana^upariṣṭāt pratibimbam āhuḥ//
body.translated_text: will have a king as her husband; they say its reflection appears above the breast.

body.text: p.130.1ab/.śīrṣe tu yasyās tilaka^alakaḥ syāt sūkṣmo bhaved añjana^cūrṇa^varṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: A woman who has a mark of fine hair on the top of her head, of collyrium-powder color,

body.text: p.130.1cd/.senāpatis tasyā bhaved dhi bhartā stana^antare +asyāḥ pratibimbakaṃ syāt//
body.translated_text: will have a general as her husband; its reflection would be between her breasts.

body.text: p.130.2ab/.bhrūvontare +asyās tilaka^alakaḥ syād duṣcāriṇīṃ tāṃ pramadāṃ vadanti/
body.translated_text: A woman who has a mark of fine hair between her eyebrows — they call her a woman of loose conduct;

body.text: p.130.2cd/.pañca^eva tasyāḥ patayo bhavanti bahv^anna^pānaṃ labhate ca nārī//
body.translated_text: she will have five husbands, and the woman will obtain abundant food and drink.

body.text: p.131.1ab/.gaṇḍasya nāsādikam adhyadeśe bhavec ca bimbaṃ tilakasya yasyāḥ/
body.translated_text: A woman who has the image of a <s>tilaka</s> in the area above the cheek and below the nose,

body.text: p.131.1cd/.tāṃ śoka^bhājaṃ pramadāṃ vadanti romapradeśe pratibimbam āhuḥ//
body.translated_text: they call her a woman destined for grief; they say its reflection is in the region of body hair.

body.text: p.131.2ab/.karṇe tu yasyās tilaka^alakaḥ syād bahu^śrutāṃ tāṃ pramadāṃ vadanti/
body.translated_text: A woman who has a mark of fine hair on the ear — they call her a woman of great learning;

body.text: p.131.2cd/.bahu^śrūtāṃ tāṃ śrutidhāriṇīṃ ca trike tu yasyāḥ pratibimbakaṃ syāt//
body.translated_text: she is called learned and a retainer of what she has heard, and its reflection would be at the sacrum.

body.text: p.131.3ab/.yasya^uttaroṣṭhe tilaka^alakaḥ syāt tāṃ bhinna^satyāṃ pramadāṃ vadanti/
body.translated_text: A woman who has a mark of fine hair on the upper lip — they call her a woman who breaks her vows;

body.text: p.131.3cd/.kṛcchreṇa sā vai labhate hi vṛttim ūrau tu tasyās tila^bimbam āhuḥ//
body.translated_text: she obtains her livelihood with difficulty, and they say its sesame-mark reflection is on the thigh.

body.text: p.132.1ab/.yasyā +adharoṣṭhe tilaka^alakaḥ syād duścāriṇīṃ tāṃ pramadāṃ vadanti/
body.translated_text: A woman who has a mark of fine hair on the lower lip — they call her a woman of loose conduct;

body.text: p.132.1cd/.miṣṭa^anna^pānaṃ bahu ṛcchate sā tathā hi guhye pratibimbakaṃ syāt//
body.translated_text: she obtains much sweet food and drink, and its reflection would be in the private parts.

body.text: p.132.2ab/.cibuke tu yasyās tilaka^alakaḥ syād duścāriṇīṃ tāṃ pramadāṃ vadanti/
body.translated_text: A woman who has a mark of fine hair on the chin — they call her a woman of loose conduct;

body.text: p.132.2cd/.miṣṭa^anna^pānaṃ bahu sā labheta guhye dvitīyaṃ pratibimbakaṃ syāt//
body.translated_text: she would obtain much sweet food and drink, and a second reflection would be in the private parts.

body.text: p.132.3/.ayaṃ bhoḥ puṣkarasāriṃs tilaka^adhyāyo nāma^adhyāyaḥ/
body.translated_text: This, sir <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, is the chapter called 'The Chapter on <s>Tilaka</s>.'

body.text: p.132.4/.atha khalu bhoḥ puṣkarasārin nakṣatra^janma^guṇaṃ nāma^adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmi/ tac chrūyatāṃ/ kathayatu bhavān triśaṅkko/
body.translated_text: Now then, sir <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, I shall explain the chapter called 'Birth Qualities by <s>Nakṣatra</s>.' Please hear it. 'Speak, <s>Triśaṅku</s>.'

body.text: p.132.5a/.kṛttikāsu naro jātas tejasvī priya^sāhasaḥ/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Kṛttikā</s> will be splendid, fond of daring deeds,

body.text: p.132.5b/.bhavec chūras tathā caṇḍaḥ priya^vādī ca mānavaḥ//
body.translated_text: valiant, fierce, and sweet-spoken.

body.text: p.132.6a/.rohiṇyāṃ puruṣo jāto dhanavān dharmikas tathā/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Rohiṇī</s> will be wealthy, righteous,

body.text: p.132.6b/.vyavasāyī sthiraḥ śūro dhruvaṃ ca^asya sadā mukhaṃ//
body.translated_text: industrious, steadfast, brave, and his face will always be radiant.

body.text: p.133.1ab/.jāto mṛgaśire yas tu mṛduḥ saumyas tu mānavaḥ/
body.translated_text: One born under <s>Mṛgaśiras</s> will be a man who is gentle, mild,

body.text: p.133.1cd/.darśanīyo bhavec ca^asau strī^kāntas tu viśeṣataḥ//
body.translated_text: handsome, and especially beloved by women.

body.text: p.133.2ab/.ārdrā^jātas tu hiṃsātmā caṇḍaḥ parama^jalpakaḥ/
body.translated_text: One born under <s>Ārdrā</s> will be violent in nature, fierce, extremely talkative,

body.text: p.133.2cd/.rodrakarmā bhavec ca^asāv īścaraś ca śatair mahān//
body.translated_text: engaged in terrible deeds, and a great master of hundreds.

body.text: p.133.3ab/.jātaḥ punarvasau yas tu hy alolo buddhimān naraḥ/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Punarvasu</s> will be steady, intelligent,

body.text: p.133.3cd/.dharma^śīlo bhavec ca^asau jāta^krodhaś ca mānavaḥ//
body.translated_text: righteous in character, though prone to anger.

body.text: p.133.4ab/.puṣyeṇa puruṣo jātas tejasvī brāhmaṇo bhavet/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Puṣya</s> — if a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, he will be splendid;

body.text: p.133.4cd/.kṣatriyaś ca bhaved rājā vaiśya^sūdrau ca pūjitau//
body.translated_text: if a <s>Kṣatriya</s>, he will be a king; if a <s>Vaiśya</s> or <s>Śūdra</s>, he will be honored.

body.text: p.133.5ab/.śvasanaḥ krodhanaḥ krūro hy aśleṣā^sambhavo naraḥ/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Āśleṣā</s> will be a panting, wrathful, cruel person,

body.text: p.133.5cd/.durmanuṣyaś ca caṇḍaś ca; iti sarvam ihādiśet//
body.translated_text: a base man, fierce — thus one should declare regarding all [his traits].

body.text: p.133.6ab/.bahu^prajñaḥ śrāddha^karo bahu^bhāgyas tathā^eva ca/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Maghā</s> will be very wise, a performer of <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rites),

body.text: p.133.6cd/.dhanavān dhānyavān bhogī maghāsu puruṣo bhavet//
body.translated_text: very fortunate, wealthy, rich in grain, and given to enjoyment.

body.text: p.133.7ab/.pūrvaphālgunī^jātas tu yaḥ kaścit puruṣo bhavet/
body.translated_text: Whatever man is born under <s>Pūrvaphālgunī</s>,

body.text: p.133.7cd/.ardham abucchiśīlaś ca guru^dārā^abhimardakaḥ//
body.translated_text: he will be of a nature that is half-inclined to begging and an assaulter of his teacher's wife.

body.text: p.133.8ab/.uttarāyāṃ tu phālgunyāṃ jāto bhavati bhogavān/
body.translated_text: One born under <s>Uttaraphālgunī</s> will be given to enjoyment.

body.text: p.133.8cd/.divyajñānaś ca vijñāne puruṣaḥ subhago bhavet//
body.translated_text: And one born under (the constellation) of divine knowledge would be a fortunate person in matters of understanding.

body.text: p.133.9ab/.haste jātaś ca śuddha^ātmā vikrānto mṛdu^bhojanaḥ/
body.translated_text: One born under <s>Hasta</s> is pure of soul, valiant, and a gentle eater;

body.text: p.133.9cd/.senāpatyam ca kurute +asteya^karmā bhaved asau//
body.translated_text: he attains the rank of general, and he is one who refrains from stealing.

body.text: p.133.10ab/.citrāsu jātaś citrā^akṣas tathā citra^kathā^karaḥ/
body.translated_text: One born under <s>Citrā</s> has variegated eyes and is a teller of various tales;

body.text: p.133.10cd/.darśanīyo bahu^strīkaś citra^śīlo bhaven naraḥ//
body.translated_text: he is handsome, has many women, and is a man of colorful character.

body.text: p.134.1ab/.svātyāṃ ca puruṣo jāto bandhuś lāghī cicakṣaṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Svāti</s> is a kinsman, agile, discerning,

body.text: p.134.1cd/.mṛdukaḥ pāna^śauṇḍaś ca mitra^kārī vicāravān//
body.translated_text: gentle, fond of drink, a maker of friends, and thoughtful.

body.text:
p.134.2ab/.viśākhāsu naro jātas tejasvī dravyavān mahān/
p.134.2cd/.śūro vikramavān dakṣaḥ subhagaś ca bhaved asau//
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Viśākhā</s> is brilliant, wealthy, great, heroic, valorous, skillful, and fortunate.

body.text: p.134.3ab/.anurādhā^udbhavo martyo mitravān saṃgrahī naraḥ/
body.translated_text: A mortal born under <s>Anurādhā</s> is a man with friends, sociable,

body.text: p.134.3cd/.śuciś ca^eva kṛta^jñaś ca dharma^ātmā ca bhavec ca saḥ//
body.translated_text: pure, grateful, righteous in soul, and he becomes such.

body.text: p.134.4ab/.jyeṣṭhāsu puruṣo jāto mitravān abhijāyate/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> is born with friends,

body.text: p.134.4cd/.dhanurveda^abhirāmaś ca nārīṣu kurute manaḥ//
body.translated_text: delighting in the science of archery, and he sets his mind upon women.

body.text: p.134.5ab/.mūleṣu puruṣo jāto +akṛtajñaḥ syād adharmikaḥ/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Mūla</s> would be ungrateful and unrighteous,

body.text: p.134.5cd/.dṛḍho vīro bhavec ca^asau kilviṣī ca sa mānavaḥ//
body.translated_text: firm, heroic, and that person is also sinful.

body.text: p.134.6ab/.āṣāḍhāsu ca pūrvāsu matsarī calita^indriyaḥ/
body.translated_text: One born under <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s> is envious and of unsteady senses,

body.text: p.134.6cd/.matsya^māṃsa^priyaś ca^api ghātakaḥ syāt sa mānavaḥ//
body.translated_text: fond of fish and meat, and that person would be a killer.

body.text: p.134.7ab/.sa^anukrośaś ca dātā ca vidyāniṣṭhaḥ suhṛjjanaḥ/
body.translated_text: Compassionate, generous, devoted to learning, a friend to people —

body.text: p.134.7cd/.viśvadaive naro jāto bhaved api ca niścitaḥ//
body.translated_text: a man born under <s>Viśvadeva</s> (<s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s>) is also resolute.

body.text: p.134.8ab/.ācāryaḥ śāstra^kartā ca viśvāsī ca kriyāparaḥ/
body.translated_text: A teacher, a composer of treatises, trustworthy, and devoted to action —

body.text: p.134.8cd/.śravaṇe jata; āyuṣmān śrīmāṃś ca puruṣo bhavet//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Śravaṇa</s> would be a long-lived and prosperous person.

body.text: p.134.9ab/.anavasthita^cittaś ca ccitra^dravyaś ca mānavaḥ/
body.translated_text: A man of unstable mind and of varied possessions —

body.text: p.134.9cd/.dhaniṣṭhāsu bhavej jātaḥ puruṣaḥ sarva^śāṅkitaḥ//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s> would be a person suspicious of everything.

body.text: p.135.1ab/.vāruṇe yadi nakṣatre jāto bhavati mānavaḥ/
body.translated_text: If a man is born under the <s>Vāruṇa</s> constellation (<s>Śatabhiṣaj</s>),

body.text: p.135.1cd/.paruṣo kveṣaśīlaś ca parivādī ca sarvaśaḥ//
body.translated_text: he is harsh, quarrelsome in disposition, and a slanderer in all matters.

body.text: p.135.2ab/.jāto bhādrapadāyāṃ tu pūrvasyām iha mānavaḥ/
body.translated_text: A man born here under <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>

body.text: p.135.2cd/.cāritra^guṇa^yuktaś ca kṛta^jño mukharas tathā//
body.translated_text: is endowed with virtues of good conduct, grateful, and also talkative.

body.text: p.135.3ab/.uttarasyāṃ naro jāto bhaviṣyati vicakṣaṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s> will be discerning,

body.text: p.135.3cd/.medhāvī bahv apatyaś ca dharma^śīlo mahā^dhanaḥ//
body.translated_text: intelligent, with many offspring, righteous in character, and of great wealth.

body.text: p.135.4ab/.revatyāṃ puruṣo jāto dharma^ātmā jñāti^sevakaḥ/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Revatī</s> is righteous in soul and a servant of his kinsmen,

body.text: p.135.4cd/.daridro +alpa^dhano nityaṃ dāyako na^anusūyakaḥ//
body.translated_text: poor, always of meager wealth, generous, and free from envy.

body.text: p.135.5ab/.aśvinyāṃ puruṣo jāto bhavay ativicakṣaṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Aśvinī</s> becomes exceedingly discerning,

body.text: p.135.5cd/.mahā^jana^priyaś ca^api śūraś ca subhagaś ca saḥ//
body.translated_text: beloved by great people, heroic, and fortunate.

body.text: p.135.6ab/.bharaṇyāṃ puruṣo jātaḥ pāpā^cāro +avicakṣaṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: A man born under <s>Bharaṇī</s> is of sinful conduct and undiscerning,

body.text: p.135.6cd/.kandarpe dātukāmaś ca parataś ca^upajīvakaḥ//
body.translated_text: eager to give in matters of love, and dependent on others for his livelihood.

body.text: p.135.7/.ayaṃ bhoḥ puṣkarasārinn nakṣatra^janma^guṇo nāma^adhyāyaḥ/
body.translated_text: This, O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, is the chapter called 'Qualities of Birth under the Constellations.'

body.text: p.135.8/.paṭha bhos triśaṅko utpāta^cakraṃ nāma^adhyāyaṃ/ kathayati ca/
body.translated_text: "Recite, O <s>Triśaṅku</s>, the chapter called 'The Circle of Portents.'" And he recites:

body.text: u1 utpāta^cakra^nirdeśaḥ (p.136)
body.translated_text: Exposition of the Circle of Portents.

body.text: u1.1ab/.aṣṭāviṃśati^paryanta^kṛtsne nakṣatra^maṇḍale/
body.translated_text: In the entire circle of the twenty-eight constellations,

body.text: u1.1cd/.divyā vikārā dṛśyante sūrya^candra^grahādiṣu//
body.translated_text: celestial disturbances are seen in the sun, moon, planets, and other (luminaries).

body.text: u1.2ab/.māghasya prathame pakṣe śailo vā pārthivā yadi/
body.translated_text: If in the first half of <s>Māgha</s> (month), there is a mountain or an earthly (portent),

body.text: u1.2cd/.dhūmavṛṣṭir hi; āditye; udayati pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: and a rain of smoke is visible at sunrise,

body.text: u1.2ef/.vidyuto vā^atha dṛśyante tadā vidyāj jana^kṣayaṃ//
body.translated_text: or if lightning is seen, then one should know the destruction of people.

body.text: u1.3ab/.aśvinyām arkato dhūmo nirgacchann api chādayet/
body.translated_text: If smoke issues from the sun under <s>Aśvinī</s> and covers (the sky),

body.text: u1.3cd/.anāvṛṣṭiṃ tadā vidyāt pūrṇavarṣāṇi dvādaśa//
body.translated_text: then one should know that there will be drought for a full twelve years.

body.text: u1.4ab/.bharaṇyāṃ māgha^māse tu pītasūryo +atha dṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Māgha</s> month under <s>Bharaṇī</s> the sun appears yellow,

body.text: u1.4cd/.samantād vadhyate rāṣṭraṃ madhye durbhikṣam ādiśet//
body.translated_text: the kingdom is destroyed on all sides; in its midst one should predict famine.

body.text: u1.5ab/.phālgune kṛttikāyāṃ tu; āditye parikho yadi/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Phālguna</s> under <s>Kṛttikā</s>, there is a ring around the sun,

body.text: u1.5cd/.naśyanti karvaṭās tatra yadi devo na varṣati//
body.translated_text: the small towns there are destroyed if the sky-god does not give rain.

body.text: u1.6ab/.caitra^māse yadā puṣye sūrye kṛṣṇāṃ pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Caitra</s> month, when the sun is in <s>Puṣya</s>, a black (spot) is visible,

body.text: u1.6cd/.acirodayakāle tu kṣiti^pālo +avarudhyate//
body.translated_text: shortly after sunrise, the lord of the earth is besieged.

body.text: u1.7ab/.vaiśākhamāse ca^ardrāyām ādityaḥ pratisūryakaḥ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Vaiśākha</s> month under <s>Ārdrā</s> the sun has a mock-sun,

body.text: u1.7cd/.saṃgrāmaṃ tatra jānīyād ubhau ghātyete pārthivau//
body.translated_text: one should know a battle there; both kings are slain.

body.text: u1.8ab/.gṛhyetāṃ candra^sūryau vā jyaiṣṭhe bharaṇi^jyeṣṭhayoḥ/
body.translated_text: If the moon and sun are seized in <s>Jyaiṣṭha</s> under <s>Bharaṇī</s> or <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>,

body.text: u1.8cd/.sa^amātyo vadhyate rājā rāṣṭre durbhikṣam ādiśet//
body.translated_text: the king along with his ministers is slain; in the kingdom one should predict famine.

body.text: u1.9ab/.āṣāḍhe ca yadā^āditye pūrvabhādrapade sthite/
body.translated_text: When in <s>Āṣāḍha</s> the sun stands in <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>,

body.text: u1.9cd/.sāyāhne dṛśyate +atyarthaṃ lohito maṇḍale braṇaḥ//
body.translated_text: in the evening there appears an exceedingly red wound on the solar disk.

body.text: u1.10ab/.para^cakreṇa tad^rāṣṭraṃ ṣaṇ^māsān pīḍyate tadā/
body.translated_text: That kingdom is then afflicted by a foreign army for six months,

body.text: u1.10cd/.kṣiti^pālaś ca sa^amātyaḥ putradāreṇa vadhyate//
body.translated_text: and the lord of the earth together with his ministers is killed along with his wife and sons.

body.text: u1.11ab/.pūrvāyāṃ ca^uttarāṣāḍhāyām āṣāḍhe gṛhyate śaśī/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Āṣāḍha</s> the moon is seized under <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s> or <s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s>,

body.text: u1.11cd/.vidyād durbhikṣa^kalaha rogāṃś ca^atra vinirdiśet//
body.translated_text: one should know famine and strife, and should predict diseases there.

body.text: u1.12ab/.māse +atha śrāvaṇe mūle candra^sūryau na bhāsataḥ/
body.translated_text: If in the month of <s>Śrāvaṇa</s> under <s>Mūla</s> the moon and sun do not shine,

body.text: u1.12cd/.sphuliṅgāś ca^atra dṛśyante vidyād roga^bhayaṃ mahat//
body.translated_text: and sparks are seen there, one should know a great fear of disease.

body.text: u1.13ab/.māse +aśvayuji gṛhyetāṃ eka^pakṣendubhāskaro/(p.137)
body.translated_text: If in the month of <s>Āśvayuja</s>, the moon and sun are seized in a single fortnight,

body.text: u1.13cd/.rāja^putra^sahasrāṇāṃ tadā jāyeta saṃkṣayaḥ//
body.translated_text: then there would occur the destruction of thousands of princes.

body.text: u1.14ab/.alakṣaṇo niḥprakāśaḥ pūrṇamāsyāṃ tu kārttike/
body.translated_text: If on the full-moon day of <s>Kārttika</s>, (the moon is) without marks and without radiance,

body.text: u1.14cd/.candra^sūryāv agnivarṇau rakta^varṇe nabhas^tale//
body.translated_text: and the moon and sun are fire-colored, of red hue, in the firmament —

body.text: u1.15ab/.ravivad bhāti tad^rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyeta punaḥ punaḥ/
body.translated_text: that kingdom, shining like the sun, would be destroyed again and again;

body.text: u1.15cd/.rājñāṃ vidyād dhatānāṃ vai bhūmiḥ pāstyati śoṇitaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should know that the earth of slain kings will drink blood.

body.text: u1.16ab/.bharaṇyāṃ māgha^māse tu kṛṣṇo vāyuḥ samutthitaḥ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Māgha</s> month under <s>Bharaṇī</s> a black wind arises

body.text: u1.16cd/.chādayec candra^sūryau tu śīghraṃ rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati//
body.translated_text: and covers the moon and sun, the kingdom is quickly destroyed.

body.text: u1.17ab/.māse tu phālgune vāyuḥ pāṃśuvarṣaṃ savidyutaṃ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Phālguna</s> month a wind (blows) with a rain of dust and lightning,

body.text: u1.17cd/.vadhyante pūrvarājānaḥ pratiṣṭhante tathā^apare//
body.translated_text: the former kings are slain and others are established (in their place).

body.text: u1.18ab/.saha^ādityena candre +atha yadā kaścid grahaś caret/
body.translated_text: When some planet moves along with the sun near the moon,

body.text: u1.18cd/.vāyur vā viṣamo vātii vidyād rāja^vadhaṃ tadā//
body.translated_text: or an adverse wind blows, one should know the death of the king at that time.

body.text: u1.19ab/.aśanyulke tu vaiśākhe; ādityena saha^utthite/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Vaiśākha</s> meteors and thunderbolts arise together with the sun,

body.text: u1.19cd/.ṣaṇ^māsa^abhyantareṇa^atha rāṣṭre vyasanam ādiśet//
body.translated_text: within six months one should predict calamity in the kingdom.

body.text: u1.20ab/.jyeṣṭha^māse yadā^ādityo grahato nirgato bhavet/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Jyeṣṭha</s> month the sun emerges from a planet,

body.text: u1.20cd/.ādityasya^upaghātena grahāḥ sarve +atha pīḍitāḥ//
body.translated_text: by the affliction of the sun all the planets are distressed.

body.text: u1.21ab/.jyeṣṭhe ca pāṃśur varṣeta; ādityaḥ pariviṣyate/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Jyeṣṭha</s> dust rains and the sun is encircled by a halo,

body.text: u1.21cd/.kṣiti^pāla^sahasrāṇāṃ eka; ekas tu vadhyate//
body.translated_text: among thousands of lords of the earth, one particular one is slain.

body.text: u1.22ab/.āṣāḍhe vāyavo vānti gacchanto bharaṇī^sthitāḥ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Āṣāḍha</s> winds blow, moving while situated in <s>Bharaṇī</s>,

body.text: u1.22cd/.udapānāni śuṣyante sarva^śasyaṃ ca śuṣyati//
body.translated_text: wells dry up and all crops wither.

body.text: u1.23ab/.śrāvaṇe vāyavaḥ pītāḥ sadā kṛṣṇaṃ nabhas^talaṃ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Śrāvaṇa</s> the winds are yellow and the sky is always dark,

body.text: u1.23cd/.bhayaṃ tatra vijānīyāt samantāt samupasthitaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should know that fear has arisen on all sides.

body.text: u1.24ab/.śrāvaṇe varṣate hy agniḥ pūrvabhādrapade divā/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Śrāvaṇa</s> fire rains during the day under <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>,

body.text: u1.24cd/.meghāḥ śabdam utkurvanti roga^durbhikṣam ādiśet//
body.translated_text: and the clouds make sounds, one should predict disease and famine.

body.text: u1.25ab/.yadā bhādrapade māse nabhaḥ syāc channa^garjitaṃ/(p.138)
body.translated_text: If in <s>Bhādrapada</s> month the sky thunders while overcast,

body.text: u1.25cd/.para^cakraṃ tadā rāṣṭre harate dhana^sañcayaṃ//
body.translated_text: then a foreign army in that kingdom carries away the accumulated wealth.

body.text: u1.26ab/.aśvayuji vāta^vṛṣṭiḥ syād āgatya^uttarāṃ diśaṃ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Āśvayuja</s> there is a wind-storm coming from the northern direction,

body.text: u1.26cd/.pātayec ca^evam āghātaṃ kṛtsnaṃ rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati//
body.translated_text: and it inflicts destruction, the entire kingdom is destroyed.

body.text: u1.27ab/.kārttike śukla^trayodaśyāṃ yadā candre dhanur bhavet/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Kārttika</s> on the bright thirteenth, a bow (rainbow) appears in the moon,

body.text: u1.27cd/.samantān naśyate rāṣṭraṃ madhye durbhikṣam ādiśet//
body.translated_text: the kingdom is destroyed on all sides; in its midst one should predict famine.

body.text: u1.28ab/.ulkā^pātā hy aśanayo māgha^māse bhavanti vā/
body.translated_text: If meteors and thunderbolts occur in <s>Māgha</s> month,

body.text: u1.28cd/.aśvinyāṃ viṣaye tatra prajā +aśvāsena vadhyate//
body.translated_text: the people in that region under <s>Aśvinī</s> are killed by suffocation.

body.text: u1.29ab/.māse tu phālgune yatra; āgnivarṣaṃ nabhas^talāt/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Phālguna</s> month, from the firmament,

body.text: u1.29cd/.bhavec chabdas tadākāśe tad^rāṣṭraṃ naśyate laghu//
body.translated_text: a rain of fire occurs and sound is heard in the sky, that kingdom is swiftly destroyed.

body.text: u1.30ab/.svātyāṃ caitre yadā varṣaṃ niruddhaṃ vāta^varṣitaṃ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Caitra</s> under <s>Svāti</s> rain is obstructed and blown by wind,

body.text: u1.30cd/.dṛśyata^indradhanuḥ kṣipraṃ nagaraṃ tad vinaśyate//
body.translated_text: and a rainbow is quickly seen, that city is destroyed.

body.text: u1.31ab/.bharaṇyāṃ jyeṣṭha^māse tu śabda; uttarato bhavet/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Jyeṣṭha</s> month under <s>Bharaṇī</s> a sound comes from the north,

body.text: u1.31cd/.pītavarṇaṃ tadākāśaṃ para^cakra^bhayaṃ bhavet//
body.translated_text: and the sky is yellow-colored, there is fear of a foreign army.

body.text: u1.32ab/.āṣāḍhe māsi puṣye +atha dṛśyante vyogni vidyutaḥ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Āṣāḍha</s> month under <s>Puṣya</s>, lightning without fire is seen,

body.text: u1.32cd/.satṛṇa^udakavṛṣṭibhis tribhāgaṃ mucyate prajā//
body.translated_text: a third of the people are freed by rains of grass and water.

body.text: u1.33ab/.śrāvaṇe tu yadā mūle bahu devaḥ pravarṣati/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Śrāvaṇa</s> under <s>Mūla</s> the sky-god rains abundantly,

body.text: u1.33cd/.dṛśyata^indradhanus tatra kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: and a rainbow is seen there, there is great fear for the <s>Kṣatriyas</s>.

body.text: u1.34ab/.māse bhādrapade yatra nirghātaḥ patati kṣitau/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Bhādrapada</s> month an earthquake strikes the ground,

body.text: u1.34cd/.sukṛcchrā vāyavo vānti mahad^roga^bhayaṃ tadā//
body.translated_text: and fierce winds blow, then there is great fear of disease.

body.text: u1.35ab/.māse bhādrapade puṣye vidigbhyo niścared dhvaniḥ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Bhādrapada</s> under <s>Puṣya</s> a sound issues from (various) directions,

body.text: u1.35cd/.kṣatriyaḥ kupyate kṣipraṃ vipakṣā tu datā prajā//
body.translated_text: a <s>Kṣatriya</s> becomes angry quickly, and the people are given over to the enemy faction.

body.text: u1.36ab/.bharaṇyām aśvayuje śabda upariṣṭād bhaved yadi/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Āśvayuja</s> under <s>Bharaṇī</s> a sound comes from above,

body.text: u1.36cd/.satṛṇaṃ ca^utsṛjet pāṃśuṃ tāpasānāṃ mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: and dust mixed with grass is released, there is great fear for the ascetics.

body.text: u1.37ab/.kārttike tu yadā^ārdrāyāṃ śabdaḥ śrayeta bhairavaḥ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Kārttika</s> under <s>Ārdrā</s> a terrifying sound resounds,

body.text: u1.37cd/.catuṣpadaḥ kārṣakāṇāṃ mṛtyuṃ tatra vinirdiśet//
body.translated_text: one should predict death for quadrupeds and farmers there.

body.text: u1.38ab/.mārgaśīrṣe dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ tūryaśabdo +ambare bhavet/(p.139)
body.translated_text: If in <s>Mārgaśīrṣa</s> under <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s> a sound of drums is heard in the sky,

body.text: u1.38cd/.vātāturas tadā rāṣṭre vyādhir bhavati dāruṇaḥ//
body.translated_text: then in the kingdom a severe disease caused by wind afflicts (the people).

body.text: u1.39ab/.pauṣa^māse yadā svātyāṃ śabdo bhavati bhairavaḥ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Pauṣa</s> month under <s>Svāti</s> a terrifying sound occurs,

body.text: u1.39cd/.abhīkṣṇaṃ vidyud ākāśe paṇḍitānāṃ mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: and there is constant lightning in the sky, there is great fear for the learned.

body.text: u1.40ab/.māghe śukle tu nirghāto nityaṃ śāmyed vasundharāṃ/
body.translated_text: If in bright <s>Māgha</s> an earthquake constantly shakes the earth,

body.text: u1.40cd/.jānīyāt tṛtīye varṣe sakalaṃ rāṣṭravibhramaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should know that in the third year there will be complete upheaval of the kingdom.

body.text: u1.41ab/.jyeṣṭhāyāṃ phālgune māse kṛṣṇa^vāyuḥ samākulaḥ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Phālguna</s> month under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> a black wind rages,

body.text: u1.41cd/.abhīkṣṇaṃ kampate bhūmir brahma^cāri^bhayaṃ tadā//
body.translated_text: and the earth trembles constantly, then there is fear for the celibate students.

body.text: u1.42ab/.pūrvabhādrapadāyāṃ tu caitre kampet kṣitir divā/
body.translated_text: If under <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s> in <s>Caitra</s> the earth trembles during the day,

body.text: u1.42cd/.tasmin varṣe ca tadrāṣṭre parasainyān mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: in that year and in that kingdom there is great fear from enemy armies.

body.text: u1.43ab/.pūrvāyāṃ ced āṣāḍhāyāṃ rātrau caitre ca niścalet/
body.translated_text: If under <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s> in <s>Caitra</s> (the earth) quakes at night,

body.text: u1.43cd/.asibhir hanyate rājā hanyate ca mahā^janaḥ//
body.translated_text: the king is slain by swords and the great people are killed.

body.text: u1.44ab/.vaiśākhe kampitā bhūmiḥ kṛṣṇa^pakṣe hy abhīkṣṇaśaḥ/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Vaiśākha</s> the earth trembles constantly in the dark fortnight,

body.text: u1.44cd/.anāvṛṣṭyā tu durbhikṣaṃ māsān ṣaṭ tatra nirdiśet//
body.translated_text: one should predict famine from drought there for six months.

body.text: u1.45ab/.jyeṣṭhe māse bharaṇyāṃ tu divā kamped vasundharā/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Jyeṣṭha</s> month under <s>Bharaṇī</s> the earth trembles during the day,

body.text: u1.45cd/.vidyād yodha^sahasrāṇāṃ mahī pāsyati śoṇitaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should know that the earth will drink the blood of thousands of warriors.

body.text: u1.46ab/.jyeṣṭhe māse yadā mūle rātrau bhūmiḥ prakampate/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Jyeṣṭha</s> month under <s>Mūla</s> the earth trembles at night,

body.text: u1.46cd/.pratyanto vadhyate rājā rāṣṭre baliṃ samādiśet//
body.translated_text: a border king is slain, and tribute is imposed upon the kingdom.

body.text: u1.47ab/.āṣāḍhe kampate bhūmiḥ puṣya^nakṣatra^saṃsthite/
body.translated_text: If in <s>Āṣāḍha</s> the earth trembles when the <s>Puṣya</s> constellation is situated (overhead),

body.text: u1.47cd/.śasyaṃ vinaśyate tatra kalikarma ca jāyate//
body.translated_text: the crops there are destroyed and strife arises.

body.text: u1.48ab/.prakampante yadā caityā; ādrāyāṃ vā maghāsu vā/
body.translated_text: When shrines tremble under <s>Ārdrā</s> or <s>Maghā</s>,

body.text: u1.48cd/.jvaleyuḥ prapateyur vā naśyed rāṣṭraṃ tadā laghu//
body.translated_text: or burst into flame or collapse, then the kingdom is swiftly destroyed.

body.text: u1.49ab/.caityā yatra prakampante hasanti ca namanti ca/
body.translated_text: Where shrines tremble, laugh, and bow,

body.text: u1.49cd/.sarāṣṭraḥ kṣitipas tatra na cirān nāśam arcchati//
body.translated_text: there the lord of the earth along with his kingdom meets destruction before long.

body.text: u1.50ab/.śrāvaṇe kampate bhūmiḥ pūrvabhādrapadā^sthite/(p.140)
body.translated_text: If in <s>Śrāvaṇa</s> the earth trembles when situated in <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s>,

body.text: u1.50cd/.sadā parājito rājā caura^rāṣṭre ca vadhyate//
body.translated_text: the king is constantly defeated and is slain in a kingdom of thieves.

body.text: u1.51ab/.kārttike kṣiti^kampena yadā caityaṃ viśīryate/
body.translated_text: When in the month of <s>Kārttika</s> a <s>caitya</s> (shrine) crumbles due to an earthquake,

body.text: u1.51cd/.dvāraṃ vā nagarasya^atha bhūyiṣṭhaṃ naśyate prajā//
body.translated_text: or the gate of a city [collapses], the people shall perish in great numbers.

body.text: u1.52ab/.vāme vā kaṣīṇe candroḥ śṛṅge tiṣṭhed bṛhaspatiḥ/
body.translated_text: When <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter) stands on the left or diminished horn of the moon,

body.text: u1.52cd/.mahā^bhogā vinaśyeyuḥ prakāśāḥ pṛthivīśvarāḥ//
body.translated_text: the great and illustrious lords of the earth shall be destroyed.

body.text: u1.53ab/.sūryācandramasoḥ sṛṅge lohita^aṅgo yadā +aruhet/
body.translated_text: When <s>Lohitāṅga</s> (Mars) ascends the horn of the sun and moon,

body.text: u1.53cd/.krūra^akṣamantrikāt pīḍāṃ pratyantānāṃ vinirdiśet//
body.translated_text: one should predict affliction of the border regions from a fierce, scheming enemy.

body.text: u1.54ab/.śanaiścaro yadā śṛṅge somasya^abhiruhet tadā/
body.translated_text: When <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn) ascends the horn of the moon,

body.text: u1.54cd/.jñeyaṃ roga^bhayaṃ ghoraṃ durbhikṣaṃ ca^atra nirdiśet//
body.translated_text: one should know of terrible danger from disease, and predict famine as well.

body.text: u1.55ab/.rāhuṇā nigṛhītas tu ca^ullkayā hanyate śaśī/
body.translated_text: When the moon is seized by <s>Rāhu</s> and struck by a meteor,

body.text: u1.55cd/.ṣaṇ^māsa^abhyantarāt tatra rājño vyasanam ādiśet//
body.translated_text: within six months one should predict disaster for the king.

body.text: u1.56ab/.yasya caiva^atha nakṣatre śaśī sūryo vigṛhyate/
body.translated_text: When the moon or the sun is seized in one's own <s>nakṣatra</s> (constellation)

body.text: u1.56cd/.rāhuṇā kṣitiyo rājyaiḥ saha pīḍām avāpnuyāt//
body.translated_text: by <s>Rāhu</s>, the king together with his kingdom shall suffer affliction.

body.text: u1.57ab/.rājño vai ca^atha nakṣatre candraṃ ketur yadā viśet/
body.translated_text: When a comet enters the moon in the king's <s>nakṣatra</s>,

body.text: u1.57cd/.pratyanta^rājabhiḥ sārdhaṃ śastrām ūrcchāṃ vinirdiśet//
body.translated_text: one should predict a military conflict with the kings of the border regions.

body.text: u1.58ab/.candra^madhya^gataḥ śukraḥ phālgunyātha maghā yadā/
body.translated_text: When <s>Śukra</s> (Venus) is positioned in the middle of the moon during <s>Phālgunī</s> or <s>Maghā</s>,

body.text: u1.58cd/.sarva^dhānyāni śuṣyeyus tadā rogaṃ vinirdiśet//
body.translated_text: all grains shall wither, and one should predict disease.

body.text: u1.59ab/.bṛhaspatiś ca śukraś ca lohita^aṅgaḥ śanaiścaraḥ/
body.translated_text: When <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter), <s>Śukra</s> (Venus), <s>Lohitāṅga</s> (Mars), and <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn)

body.text: u1.59cd/.likhyanti soma^śṛṅgasya tadā vidyān mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: scratch the horn of the moon, then one should know of great danger.

body.text: u1.60ab/.dhūmaketur mahā^bhāgaḥ puṣyam āruhya tiṣṭhati/
body.translated_text: When the great and splendid comet (<s>dhūmaketu</s>) ascends and stands upon <s>Puṣya</s>,

body.text: u1.60cd/.catur^diśaṃ tadā viṃcyāt para^cakraiḥ parābhavaṃ//
body.translated_text: then one should expect defeat from enemy forces in all four directions.

body.text: u1.61ab/.maghāyāṃ lohita^aṅgo vā śravaṇe vā bṛhaspatiḥ/
body.translated_text: When <s>Lohitāṅga</s> (Mars) stands in <s>Maghā</s> or <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter) in <s>Śravaṇa</s>,

body.text: u1.61cd/.tiṣṭhet saṃvatsara^trīṇi bhayaṃ vidyāt samāgaraṃ//
body.translated_text: one should know of combined danger for three years.

body.text: u1.62ab/.tiṣṭhec chukro +atha rohiṇyāṃ jyeṣṭhe māse kathaṃcana/
body.translated_text: When <s>Śukra</s> (Venus) stands in <s>Rohiṇī</s> in the month of <s>Jyeṣṭha</s> under any circumstances,

body.text: u1.62cd/.vyākuryān niyatam atra kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: it would certainly portend great danger for the <s>Kṣatriyas</s>.

body.text: u1.63ab/.viśākhāyāṃ samīpasthau bṛhaspati^śanaiścarau/(p.141)
body.translated_text: When <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter) and <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn) stand near <s>Viśākhā</s>,

body.text: u1.63cd/.somo vā raviṇā sārdhaṃ para^cakra^bhayaṃ tadā//
body.translated_text: or the moon together with the sun — then there is danger from enemy forces.

body.text: u1.64ab/.kākāḥ śyenāś ca bṛdhrāś ca vaseyuḥ sahitā mudā/
body.translated_text: When crows, hawks, and vultures dwell together in harmony,

body.text: u1.64cd/.maithunaṃ vāritaṃ veyuḥ paraiḥ saha raṇas tadā//
body.translated_text: or when their mating is obstructed, then there shall be battle with enemies.

body.text: u1.65ab/.śyeno hastinivāse vā; abhirohet punaḥ punaḥ/
body.translated_text: When a hawk repeatedly alights upon the elephant stable,

body.text: u1.65cd/.para^cakreṇa yuddhaṃ tu bhavec ca^api punaḥ punaḥ/.
body.translated_text: there shall be battle with enemy forces again and again.

body.text: u1.66ab/.kanyā prasūyate yatra catur^hastā catustanī/
body.translated_text: Where a girl is born with four arms and four breasts,

body.text: u1.66cd/.strīṇām eva bhavet tatra maraṇaṃ hy atidāruṇaṃ//
body.translated_text: there shall be a most terrible death of women in that place.

body.text: u1.67ab/.garbha^sthā dārakā yatra hasanti ca vadanti ca/
body.translated_text: Where unborn children in the womb laugh and speak,

body.text: u1.67cd/.tasya deśasya jānīyād vināśaṃ samupasthitaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should know that destruction of that land is at hand.

body.text: u1.68ab/.eka^pādāṃ stripādāṃś ca catur^aṅgāṃs tathā^eva ca/
body.translated_text: Where women give birth to one-footed, three-footed,

body.text: u1.68cd/.nāryo yatra prasūyante rājño vyasanam ādiśet//
body.translated_text: or four-limbed [beings], one should predict disaster for the king.

body.text: u1.69ab/.sūyante vikṛtān garbhān santānān bhaya^vyañjanān/
body.translated_text: Where women give birth to deformed fetuses, to offspring bearing signs of danger,

body.text: u1.69cd/.pramadā yatra deśe tu rājā tatra vinaśyati//
body.translated_text: in that region, the king shall perish.

body.text: u1.70ab/.laghu^hasta^śīrṣa^mukhān mānuṣaṃ kāyam aśritān/
body.translated_text: Where women give birth to beings with small hands, heads, and faces in human form,

body.text: u1.70cd/.pramadā yatra sūyante rāṣṭraṃ tatra vinaśyati//
body.translated_text: in that place, the kingdom shall be destroyed.

body.text: u1.71ab/.kharāś ca mahiṣāś ca^api paśavo +atha tathāvidhāḥ/
body.translated_text: When donkeys, buffaloes, and other such animals

body.text: u1.71cd/.dvi^tri^śīrṣāḥ prasūyante deśe yatra sa naśyati//
body.translated_text: give birth to two-headed or three-headed [offspring], that land shall be destroyed.

body.text: u1.72ab/.śṛgāla^śvāna^makara^hayarūpāś ca mānavāḥ/
body.translated_text: Where humans are born with the forms of jackals, dogs, crocodiles, or horses,

body.text: u1.72cd/.jāyante yatra deśe tu sa deśo laghu naśyati//
body.translated_text: that land shall quickly be destroyed.

body.text: u1.73ab/.pādāv ubhau yadā vaiśyā gurviṇī saṃprasūyate/
body.translated_text: When a <s>Vaiśya</s> woman who is pregnant gives birth to both feet [first],

body.text: u1.73cd/.deśasya vilayaṃ brūyāt para^cakreṇa dāruṇaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should declare the terrible destruction of the land by enemy forces.

body.text: u1.74ab/.pūrvārdhaḥ pakṣinarayor garbho yatra prasūyate/
body.translated_text: Where a fetus is born with the front half of a bird and the back half of a man,

body.text: u1.74cd/.rājā vā rājāmātyo vā saha deśena naśyati//
body.translated_text: the king or the king's minister together with the land shall perish.

body.text: u1.75ab/.kumbhāṇḍo jāyate yatra dvisukho +atha catur^mukhaḥ/(p.142)
body.translated_text: Where a <s>Kumbhāṇḍa</s> (demon) is born with two phalluses or four faces,

body.text: u1.75cd/.trinetras trimukho vā^api vidyāt tatra mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: or with three eyes or three faces — one should know of great danger there.

body.text:
u1.76ab/.saukareṇa tu vakreṇa śarīraṃ mānuṣaṃ yadi/
u1.76cd/.sūtaṃ catur^diśaṃ rāṣṭraṃ hanyāt tatra na saṃśayaḥ//
body.translated_text: If a human body is born with a curved, pig-like [face], the kingdom in all four directions shall be destroyed — there is no doubt.

body.text: u1.77ab/.ādityasya tu rūpeṇa mānuṣo yatra jāyate/
body.translated_text: Where a human being is born with the appearance of the sun,

body.text: u1.77cd/.vibhramāt sakalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ vināśam upagacchati//
body.translated_text: the entire kingdom goes to destruction through upheaval.

body.text: u1.78ab/.uttānaśāyī bālas tu deśaṃ yatra dvijottamaḥ/
body.translated_text: Where a child lying on its back, O best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>,

body.text: u1.78cd/.dṛṣṭaḥ pravyāharan vedān kṣipraṃ deśo vinaśyatei//
body.translated_text: is seen reciting the <s>Vedas</s>, that land shall quickly be destroyed.

body.text: u1.79ab/.kukṣiṃ bhitvā yadā bālo garbhān niṣkramate svayaṃ/
body.translated_text: When a child bursts through the belly and comes out of the womb on its own,

body.text: u1.79cd/.atrāṇāṃ mātaraṃ kṛtvā sa deśo naśyate laghu//
body.translated_text: leaving the mother unprotected, that land shall quickly perish.

body.text: u1.80ab/.garbha^sthāḥ sūkarā; uṣṭrāḥ sarpāś ca śakunis tathā/
body.translated_text: When pigs, camels, serpents, and birds

body.text: u1.80cd/.strīṇāṃ garbhāt prasūyante deśe tu bhayam ādiśet//
body.translated_text: are born from the wombs of women, one should predict danger in that land.

body.text: u1.81ab/.pauruṣaṃ gārdabhaṃ ca^atha saukaraṃ ca^ardha^vigrahaṃ/
body.translated_text: Where cows give birth to beings with half-human, half-donkey,

body.text: u1.81cd/.gāvo yatra prasūyante nirdiśed bhayam āgataṃ//
body.translated_text: or half-pig form, one should declare that danger has arrived.

body.text: u1.82ab/.nārī gṛhṇāti garbhaṃ vā; adṛṣṭa^stana^rūpiṇī/
body.translated_text: When a woman conceives or is seen without the form of breasts,

body.text: u1.82cd/.vināśaṃ tasya deśasya sanṛpasya vinirdiśet//
body.translated_text: one should predict the destruction of that land together with its king.

body.text: u1.83ab/.jaṭī dīrghanakho yatra sukṛṣṇaḥ paruṣa^cchaviḥ/
body.translated_text: Where one with matted hair, long nails, very dark complexion, and rough skin

body.text: u1.83cd/.sajano jāyate yatra rāṣṭraṃ sādhipatiṃ dahet//
body.translated_text: is born with companions, that kingdom together with its ruler shall burn.

body.text: u1.84ab/.agrīvā danta^sahitā jāyante yatra bālakāḥ/
body.translated_text: Where children are born neckless and already possessing teeth,

body.text: u1.84cd/.śuṣyeta sakalaṃ śasyaṃ janaś ca vilayaṃ vrajet/
body.translated_text: all crops shall wither and the people shall go to ruin.

body.text: u1.85ab/.eka^bāhura^śīrṣo +atha garbho yatra prasūyate/
body.translated_text: Where a fetus is born with one arm and no head,

body.text: u1.85cd/.svayaṃ kṣubhyeta tad^rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyeta na saṃśayaḥ//
body.translated_text: that kingdom shall be thrown into turmoil and destroyed — there is no doubt.

body.text: u1.86ab/.phale phalaṃ yadā paśyet puṣpe vā puṣpam āśritaṃ/
body.translated_text: When one sees a fruit within a fruit, or a flower within a flower,

body.text: u1.86cd/.garbhāḥ sraveyur nārīṇāṃ yuvarājaś ca vadhyate//
body.translated_text: women shall miscarry their pregnancies, and the crown prince shall be slain.

body.text: u1.87ab/.akāle pādapā yatra puṣpyanti ca phalanti ca/(p.143)
body.translated_text: When trees flower and bear fruit out of season,

body.text: u1.87cd/.latā gulmo +atha vallī vā deśe tatra bhayaṃ bhavet//
body.translated_text: or creepers, shrubs, or vines [do so], there shall be danger in that land.

body.text: u1.88ab/.vṛkṣa^upariṣṭāt paśyed vā sravantam ātma^śoṇitam/
body.translated_text: If one sees blood dripping from the top of a tree,

body.text: u1.88cd/.kūjamānaṃ pataṅgaṃ vā tadā vidyān mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: or a bird crying [there], then one should know of great danger.

body.text: u1.89ab/.vṛkṣāṇāṃ maṇḍapānāṃ vā chāyā na parivartate/
body.translated_text: When the shadows of trees or pavilions do not move,

body.text: u1.89cd/.catur^varṇa^bhayaṃ tatra kalikarma ca jāyate//
body.translated_text: there shall be danger to all four <s>varṇas</s>, and strife-producing deeds shall arise.

body.text: u1.90ab/.puṣpyegruḥ pādapā yatra vividhāḥ puṣpa^jātayaḥ/
body.translated_text: Where trees bloom and various species of flowers

body.text: u1.90cd/.kalpa^vṛkṣa^prakṛtayas tato vidyān mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: take on the appearance of wish-fulfilling trees (<s>kalpavṛkṣa</s>), then one should know of great danger.

body.text:
u1.91ab/.anāvartaṃ yadā puṣpaṃ phalaṃ ca^api pradṛśyate/
u1.91cd/.vināśaṃ tasya deśasya durbhikṣaṃ kalahaṃ vadet//
body.translated_text: When flowers and fruit are seen that have not matured properly, one should declare the destruction of that land, famine, and quarrel.

body.text: u1.92ab/.sthānāsthānaṃ gatā vṛkṣā dṛśyeyur yatra kutracit/
body.translated_text: When trees are seen displaced from their proper and improper places anywhere,

body.text: u1.92cd/.pūrvapratiṣṭhitā rājā na cireṇa vicālyate//
body.translated_text: a previously established king shall be overthrown before long.

body.text: u1.93ab/.daiva^asuraṃ ca saṃgrāmaṃ paśyed adbhuta^darśanaṃ/
body.translated_text: When one sees a wondrous battle between <s>Devas</s> (gods) and <s>Asuras</s> (demons),

body.text: u1.93cd/.śastraṃ mūrcchayate tatra taskaraiś ca^api pūrvavat//
body.translated_text: weapons shall rise up there, and [there shall be violence] from thieves as before.

body.text: u1.94ab/.kampate rudate śāstā gacchan vā yatra dṛśyate/
body.translated_text: When a sacred image trembles, weeps, or is seen moving,

body.text: u1.94cd/.para^cakrāt tadā vidyād atyarthaṃ tatprarājayaṃ//
body.translated_text: then from an enemy army one should know of an exceedingly great defeat of that [king].

body.text: u1.95ab/.devatā yatra deśe tu nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca/
body.translated_text: Where deities dance and laugh in that land,

body.text: u1.95cd/.aśrūṇi pātayeyur vā tadā vidyān mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: or shed tears, then one should know of great danger.

body.text: u1.96ab/.devatā yatra krīḍanti jvalanti nimiṣanti vā/
body.translated_text: Where deities play, blaze, or blink,

body.text: u1.96cd/.caleyur athavā yatra kṣiti^po +anyo bhavet tadā//
body.translated_text: or where they move, then another ruler shall arise.

body.text: u1.97ab/.śivaliṅaṃ yadā kamped gagane vā^atha dṛśyate/
body.translated_text: When a <s>Śivaliṅga</s> trembles, or is seen in the sky,

body.text: u1.97cd/.nimajjate dharaṇyāṃ vā dhruvaṃ rāja^vadho bhavet//
body.translated_text: or sinks into the earth, the death of the king shall certainly occur.

body.text: u1.98ab/.pratimāḥ parivartante dhūmāyante rudanti ca/
body.translated_text: When images turn around, emit smoke, and weep,

body.text: u1.98cd/.prasvidyeyuḥ pradhāveyur anyo rājā bhaviṣyati//
body.translated_text: or sweat or run — another king shall come to be.

body.text: u1.99ab/.acalo vā calet sthānāc calaṃ vā^apy acalaṃ bhavet/
body.translated_text: When what is immovable moves from its place, or what is movable becomes immovable,

body.text: u1.99cd/.amātyo hanti rājānaṃ kalahaṃ ca^atra nirdiśet//
body.translated_text: a minister slays the king — and one should predict strife there.

body.text: u1.100ab/.vamanti rudhiraṃ kanyā namante vā diśo daśa/(p.144)
body.translated_text: When maidens vomit blood or bow to the ten directions,

body.text: u1.100cd/.ayuktā vā pravartante kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: or proceed in an uncontrolled manner — great danger for the <s>Kṣatriyas</s>.

body.text: u1.101ab/.varṣate kusumaṃ yatra rakta^vindum atha^api vā/
body.translated_text: When flowers rain down, or drops of blood,

body.text: u1.101cd/.prāṇino vividhān vā^api vidyāc caura^bhayaṃ tadā//
body.translated_text: or various living creatures [rain down], then one should know of danger from thieves.

body.text: u1.102ab/.yūpāḥ purāṇā nigamā deva^āgārāṇi caitiyāḥ/
body.translated_text: When ancient sacrificial posts, market-towns, temples, shrines,

body.text: u1.102cd/.nagarāṇy atha dhūmyante kṣipraṃ rājā vinaśyati//
body.translated_text: and cities emit smoke, the king shall quickly perish.

body.text: u1.103ab/.indur vā dīpa^vṛkso vā dīpo yatra na dīpyate/
body.translated_text: When a lamp-tree or lamp does not burn in the moon[light],

body.text: u1.103cd/.rājyakāmaḥ kumāro vā kṣubhyed viṭapako +api vā//
body.translated_text: a prince desiring the kingdom or a minister may cause unrest.

body.text: u1.104ab/.antaḥpure yadā nīḍāṃ kurvate madhu^makṣikāḥ/
body.translated_text: When honeybees build a nest in the women's quarters,

body.text: u1.104cd/.astraṃ vā^api gṛhaṃ dahyād rājño vyasanam ādiśet//
body.translated_text: or when a weapon or a house is burned — one should predict disaster for the king.

body.text: u1.105ab/.pated antaḥpure vidyud vṛkṣe vā^apy āśrame tathā/
body.translated_text: When lightning strikes in the women's quarters, or upon a tree, or likewise in a hermitage,

body.text: u1.105cd/.puri caityacchāyāyāṃ vā rājārthe patitā hi sā//
body.translated_text: or in the shadow of a shrine in the city — that has fallen for the king's purpose.

body.text: u1.106ab/.prākāre vā +ayudhāgāre gopurāsthānakeṣu vā/
body.translated_text: When upon a rampart, an armory, or gateways and platforms,

body.text: u1.106cd/.vāyasaḥ kurute nīḍaṃ sa^amātyo dhvaṃsate nṛpaḥ//
body.translated_text: a crow builds a nest — the king together with his ministers shall fall.

body.text: u1.107ab/.anāhatebhyas tūryehbhyaḥ svayaṃ śabdo viniścaret/
body.translated_text: When from unstruck musical instruments a sound issues forth on its own,

body.text: u1.107cd/.svacakra^kṣobhadoṣeṇa sarvaṃ rāṣṭraṃ vilupyate//
body.translated_text: the entire kingdom shall be plundered through the fault of internal disturbance.

body.text: u1.108ab/.māṃsa^śoṇita^varṣaṃ vā patra^puṣpa^phalāni vā/
body.translated_text: When it rains flesh and blood, or leaves, flowers, and fruits,

body.text: u1.108cd/.yadābhivarṣet tadvarṣaṃ cakrai rāṣṭraṃ vilupyate//
body.translated_text: and when that kind of rain falls, the kingdom shall be plundered by armies.

body.text: u1.109ab/.madhu^phāṇita^puṣpāṇi gandha^varṣāṇy atha^api vā/
body.translated_text: When honey, molasses, flowers, or fragrant rains

body.text: u1.109cd/.diśo dāhāś ca dṛśyeyur māra^durbhikṣa^lakṣaṇaṃ//
body.translated_text: fall, and fires in the directions are seen — it is a sign of death and famine.

body.text: u1.110ab/.meghaḥ samantato garjed upavarṣet sacātakaṃ/
body.translated_text: When clouds thunder on all sides and rain together with the <s>cātaka</s> bird,

body.text: u1.110cd/.śoṇitaṃ sakarakaṃ syāt tadā vidyāt parād bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: and the rain is blood mixed with hail, then one should know danger from enemies.

body.text: u1.111ab/.vidyuc ca patate ghorā karakāṇāṃ ca varṣaṇaṃ/
body.translated_text: When fierce lightning falls and there is a shower of hailstones,

body.text: u1.111cd/.gandharva^nagaraṃ ca^atha dṛṣṭvā vidyān mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: and a <s>gandharva</s>-city (mirage) is seen, then one should know of great danger.

body.text: u1.112ab/.śaśī śoṇita^saṃkāśo madhye kṛṣṇo vivarṇavān/(p.145)
body.translated_text: When the moon is the color of blood, dark in the middle and discolored,

body.text: u1.112cd/.sāmantakena pīḍyate vidyād rāṣṭre mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: and is afflicted by a neighboring [planet], one should know of great danger in the kingdom.

body.text: u1.113ab/.pradīpita^agni^saṃkāśo yadā dṛśyeta candramāḥ/
body.translated_text: When the moon appears like a kindled fire,

body.text: u1.113cd/.gaganaṃ dahyate tatra loka^pīḍā jvareṇa ca//
body.translated_text: the sky seems to burn, and the people are afflicted with fever.

body.text: u1.114ab/.yadā gairika^saṃkāśaḥ kṣipram eva^upaśāmyati/
body.translated_text: When it appears the color of ochre and quickly subsides,

body.text: u1.114cd/.varṣaṇasya^āgamo vidyād yadi vāyuḥ pravāyate//
body.translated_text: one should know the approach of rain, provided the wind blows.

body.text: u1.115ab/.sandhyāyāṃ dhūmra^varṇāyāṃ dṛśyetenduś ca bhāskaraḥ/
body.translated_text: When at twilight, which is smoke-colored, the moon and sun are seen

body.text: u1.115cd/.vicchinno brahma^rūpeṇa varṣaṃ tatra vinirdiśed//
body.translated_text: cut off by a <s>Brahma</s>-form, one should predict rain there.

body.text: u1.116ab/.nāpsu majjati na^apy agnau pūrvavac ca na dṛśyate/
body.translated_text: When [the moon] neither sinks in water nor in fire, and is not seen as before,

body.text: u1.116cd/.agnir utpatsyate tatra koṣṭha^āgāraṃ daheta saḥ//
body.translated_text: fire shall arise there and burn the granary.

body.text: u1.117ab/.dhvaja^agre vāyaso yatra lamba^pakṣo vidhāvate/
body.translated_text: Where a crow with drooping wings runs about on a flagstaff,

body.text: u1.117cd/.udakaṃ saṃharet kṣipram agnitaḥ sumahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should quickly collect water — there is exceedingly great danger from fire.

body.text: u1.118ab/.jalaṃ jājvalyamānaṃ tu matsyo nirdahati svayaṃ/
body.translated_text: When blazing water and fish self-ignite,

body.text: u1.118cd/.anāvṛṣṭiṃ tadā brūyād durbhikṣaṃ ca mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: then one should declare drought, famine, and great danger.

body.text: u1.119ab/.puradvāre yadā^āgacchet svayam āraṇyako mṛgaḥ/
body.translated_text: When a wild forest animal comes of its own accord to the city gate,

body.text: u1.119cd/.cakra^dvaye +api durbhikṣaṃ rāṣṭre rogaṃ ca nirdiśet//
body.translated_text: one should predict famine in both regions and disease in the kingdom.

body.text: u1.120ab/.triśīrṣaḥ pañca^śīrṣo vā yadā sarpo +atha dṛśyate/
body.translated_text: When a three-headed or five-headed serpent is seen,

body.text: u1.120cd/.anāvṛṣṭyā tadā vidyāt sarva^śasyaṃ vinaśyati//
body.translated_text: then one should know that through drought all crops shall perish.

body.text: u1.121ab/.kuśūlo yatra dṛśyeta kampayan tu vasundharāṃ/
body.translated_text: Where an earthquake is seen, shaking the earth,

body.text: u1.121cd/.koṣṭha^āgārāṇi naśyeyur ye ca^anye dhana^sañcayāḥ/
body.translated_text: granaries and storehouses shall perish, along with other accumulations of wealth.

body.text: u1.122ab/.sarpa; udyata^śīrṣas tu yudhyate puruṣaiḥ saha/
body.translated_text: A serpent with raised head fights with men;

body.text: u1.122cd/.cakra^dvayād rogataś ca vidyāt tatra mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: from a pair of wheels and from disease, one should know great danger there.

body.text: u1.123ab/.bila; ekatra bahavaḥ sarpāḥ supariveṣṭitāḥ/
body.translated_text: In a burrow, many serpents gathered together in one place —

body.text: u1.123cd/.śastra^mṛtyuṃ tadā vidyāt kṣatriyāṇāṃ mahad^bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should then know death by weapons, and great danger for the <s>Kṣatriyas</s>.

body.text: u1.124ab/.niścaranty avadhānena khaḍgāḥ prajvalitā yadā/
body.translated_text: When swords blaze forth with care,

body.text: u1.124cd/.tatas taṃ na cirāt paśyet saṃgrāmaṃ pratyupasthitaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should soon see battle imminent.

body.text: u1.125ab/.kākaḥ śyenaś ca gṛdhro vā yasya nīyeta mūrdhani/(146)
body.translated_text: A crow, a hawk, or a vulture that settles on someone's head —

body.text: u1.125cd/.ṣaṇ^māsa^abhyantare rājā mriyate sapurohitaḥ//
body.translated_text: within six months, the king dies along with his priest.

body.text: u1.126ab/.prāsādāś ca prakampante śaraṇāni gṛhāṇi ca/
body.translated_text: When palaces tremble, along with shelters and houses,

body.text: u1.126cd/.mahā^balaṃ ca vadhyeta rāṣṭrasya rāja^pālakaḥ//
body.translated_text: the great army shall be destroyed, and the ruler-protector of the kingdom.

body.text: u1.127ab/.vajra^uddhṛtā diśaḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇa^pakṣe catur^diśaṃ/
body.translated_text: When thunderbolts are hurled in all directions during the dark fortnight in the four quarters,

body.text: u1.127cd/.varṣeyuḥ śoṇitaṃ yatra kṣiti^pālo +atra vadhyate//
body.translated_text: and where blood rains down, there the lord of the earth is slain.

body.text: u1.128ab/.sūryasya^udaya^kāle tu maholkā nipated yadā/
body.translated_text: When at the time of sunrise a great meteor falls,

body.text: u1.128cd/.rāja^putra^sahasrāṇāṃ bhūmiḥ pāsyāti śoṇitaṃ//
body.translated_text: the earth will drink the blood of thousands of princes.

body.text: u1.129ab/.vṛkṣāḥ sarpāḥ prakampeyur mucyeyus tvaco vā tathā/
body.translated_text: When trees and serpents tremble, or shed their bark,

body.text: u1.129cd/.sarvasmin eva rāṣṭre tu vidyāc chatru^bhayaṃ mahat//
body.translated_text: in that entire kingdom, one should know great danger from enemies.

body.text: u1.130ab/.dine hy ulkā^prayuktir vā jvalantī yadi dṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If during the day a blazing meteor or firebrand is seen,

body.text: u1.130cd/.rakta^utpādaṃ tadā vidyāt saṃgrāmaṃ bhīma^darśanaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should know there will be bloodshed and a terrible battle.

body.text: u1.131ab/.asiṃ prajvalitaṃ paśyet tomaraṃ cakram eva ca/
body.translated_text: If one sees a blazing sword, a lance, or a discus,

body.text: u1.131cd/.vidyāt paśyanti śastrāṇi saṃgrāmaṃ bhīma^darśanaṃ//
body.translated_text: those who see such weapons should know a terrible battle is coming.

body.text: u1.132ab/.dīrgham ucchvasate vā +aśvaḥ aśrūṇi ca nipātayet/
body.translated_text: If a horse sighs deeply and sheds tears,

body.text: u1.132cd/.pādena karṣate śīghraṃ yuddhe rāja^vadho dhruvaṃ//
body.translated_text: and paws the ground swiftly, the death of the king in battle is certain.

body.text: u1.133ab/.kākaś ced gṛham āruhya hā putra; iti vāśati/
body.translated_text: If a crow, perching on a house, cries 'Alas, my son!'

body.text: u1.133cd/.sarvaḥ praṇaśyate deśo nagara^grāma^karvaṭaḥ//
body.translated_text: that entire region perishes — cities, villages, and market-towns.

body.text: u1.134ab/.anagnau jāyate dhūmaḥ sthale padmāni vā yadā/
body.translated_text: When smoke arises without fire, or lotuses bloom on dry land,

body.text: u1.134cd/.vināśaṃ tasya deśasya niyamāc chīghram ādiśet//
body.translated_text: one should predict the swift destruction of that region with certainty.

body.text: u1.135ab/.āravanti yadā ghoraṃ meghā vṛkamṛgās tathā/
body.translated_text: When clouds roar terribly, and wolves and wild beasts likewise,

body.text: u1.135cd/.vināśaṃ tasya deśasya vidyāc chīghram upasthitaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should know the swift destruction of that region is at hand.

body.text: u1.136ab/.chinnasrotā bhaven nadyaś cirakāravahā; api/
body.translated_text: When rivers that have flowed for a long time have their current cut off,

body.text: u1.136cd/.gṛhāḥ śūnyodakena^api śuṣkās tatra bhayaṃ bhavet//
body.translated_text: and houses are dried up even without water, there shall be danger.

body.text: u1.137ab/.pratisrotā yadā nadyo vahanty aprativāritāḥ/
body.translated_text: When rivers flow against their current, unchecked,

body.text: u1.137cd/.nityodvignā janapadā nirdiśec ca jana^kṣayaṃ//
body.translated_text: the inhabitants are constantly alarmed — one should predict the destruction of the people.

body.text: u1.138ab/.dhanūṃṣy ākṛZyamāṇāni dhūmāyanti jvalanti ca/(p.147)
body.translated_text: When bows being drawn smoke and blaze,

body.text: u1.138cd/.anyad vā^api praharaṇaṃ parebhyo jāyate bhayaṃ//
body.translated_text: or any other weapon likewise — danger from enemies arises.

body.text: u1.139ab/.mayūra^grīva^saṃkāśaḥ pariveśo niśākare/
body.translated_text: When a halo around the moon resembles the color of a peacock's neck,

body.text: u1.139cd/.vidyād rāja^sahasrāṇāṃ mahī pāsyati śoṇitaṃ//
body.translated_text: one should know the earth will drink the blood of thousands of kings.

body.text: u1.140ab/.narāṇāṃ pramadānāṃ ca rati^harṣo na jāyate/
body.translated_text: When the joy and delight of love does not arise in men and women,

body.text: u1.140cd/.sarvatra śoka^cintā vā mahat tatra bhayaṃ bhavet//
body.translated_text: and everywhere there is grief and anxiety, great danger shall come.

body.text: u1.141ab/.nirgranthā; ṛṣayaḥ santo deśān prakrameyur yataḥ/
body.translated_text: When unclad sages and holy men depart from a region,

body.text: u1.141cd/.nadīṃ bhitvā nikuñjānvā sa deśo naśyate +acirāt//
body.translated_text: or a river breaks its banks or its groves — that region perishes soon.

body.text: u1.142ab/.yatrauṣadhyaś ca virasā jalaṃ ca parihīyate/
body.translated_text: Where herbs become tasteless and water diminishes,

body.text: u1.142cd/.vidyād deśaṃ tam utsṛṣṭaṃ devatā^ṛṣisādhubhiḥ//
body.translated_text: one should know that region has been abandoned by gods, sages, and holy men.

body.text: u1.143ab/.matsyāḥ kūrmāś ca sarpāś ca mriyante yatra jāṅgalāḥ/
body.translated_text: Where fish, tortoises, and serpents die in dry land,

body.text: u1.143cd/.dhana^skandhaḥ striyās tatra sapatnair vipralopsyate//
body.translated_text: the wealth and women of that place shall be plundered by enemies.

body.text: u1.144ab/.apūrvāḥ pakṣiṇo yatra sthale vāriṇi; eva vā/
body.translated_text: Where birds never seen before appear, on land or in water,

body.text: u1.144cd/.dṛśyeyuḥ para^cakreṇa dhana^skandho vilopsyate//
body.translated_text: the wealth shall be plundered by an invading army.

body.text: u1.145ab/.mahā^patho yadā kakṣaiḥ prasṛtair apatho bhavet/
body.translated_text: When the great highway becomes impassable due to spreading thickets,

body.text: u1.145cd/.sagrāma^karvaṭaṃ rāṣṭraṃ putreṇa saha naśyate//
body.translated_text: the kingdom with its villages and market-towns perishes along with its ruler's son.

body.text: u1.146/.nānotpātacakra^nirdeśo nāma^adhyāyaḥ/
body.translated_text: This is the chapter called 'Description of the Circle of Various Portents.'

body.text: u1.147/.paṭha bhos triśaṅko puruṣa^pinyādhyāyaṃ/ atha kiṃ/ kathayatu bhagavān/
body.translated_text: Recite, O <s>Triśaṅku</s>, the chapter on bodily marks of a person. What then? Let the lord speak.

body.text: u1.148/.atha khalu bhoḥ puṣkarasārin puruṣa^pinyādhyāyaṃ vyākhāmi tac chrūyatāṃ/ kathayatu bhagavān/
body.translated_text: Now then, O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, I shall explain the chapter on bodily marks of a person — listen to it. Let the lord speak.

body.text:
u1.149/.aṣṭāviṃśatiḥ puṣkarasārin nakṣatrāṇi prakīrtitāni/ yāni candra^sūrya^niḥsṛtāny anuvahanti/ tatra sukugṛṣṭyā aṣṭāṅgula^pramāṇayā dvādaśākṣagṛṣṭayaḥ svaśarīraṃ (p.148) dairghyeṇa jñātavyaṃ/ ekākṣagṛṣṭiḥ śīrṣa^mūrdhni eka^pāda^talaṃ bhavet/ catur^daśa gṛṣṭayo nakṣatrāṇāṃ padaṃ yatra saṃdṛśyate/ tad anyathā na bhavati/ nakṣatre yatra yo jātas tatra
tatra saṃkṛśyate/
body.translated_text: Twenty-eight, O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, are the <s>nakṣatras</s> (lunar mansions) proclaimed, which follow the course of the moon and sun. Among these, with a half-measure, eight —

body.text: u2 puruṣa^pinyaḥ
body.translated_text: Chapter 2: Bodily Marks (<s>Puruṣapiṇya</s>)

body.text:
u2.1ab/.kṛttikāyāṃ hi jātasya mukhe vai catur^aṅgulaḥ/
u2.1cd/.pinyo dakṣiṇato yasya lomaśaḥ kṛṣṇa^lohitaḥ//
body.translated_text: One born under <s>Kṛttikā</s> has a mark of four finger-breadths on the face, on the right side, hairy and dark-red.

body.text: u2.2ab/.bhogavān yaśasā yuktaḥ paṇḍito jvalati śriyā/
body.translated_text: He is wealthy, endowed with fame, learned, and radiant with prosperity.

body.text: u2.2cd/.kṛttikāsv atha jātasya bhavaty etad dhi lakṣaṇaṃ//
body.translated_text: This is the characteristic of one born under <s>Kṛttikā</s>.

body.text: u2.3ab/.dṛśyate vraṇa; evāyaṃ yasya vai catur^aṅgulaḥ/
body.translated_text: If a mark resembling a wound of four finger-breadths is seen,

body.text: u2.3cd/.rohiṇyāṃ jātakaḥ so +api vidvān dharma^rataḥ sadā//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Rohiṇī</s> is learned and always devoted to <s>Dharma</s>.

body.text: u2.4ab/.maṇḍito bhoga^sampanno hrī^yuktaś ca^api sarvataḥ/
body.translated_text: He is adorned, endowed with enjoyments, and modest in all respects,

body.text: u2.4cd/.śūro vijaya^sampanno nityaṃ śatru^pramardakaḥ//
body.translated_text: heroic, victorious, and a constant crusher of enemies.

body.text: u2.5ab/.grīvāyām ardha^gṛṣṭyā tu dāho yasya pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If on the neck a mark of half-measure is seen as a burn,

body.text: u2.5cd/.mṛgaśīrṣe hy asau jātaḥ śūro bhoga^samarpitaḥ//
body.translated_text: that person is born under <s>Mṛgaśīrṣa</s> — heroic and endowed with enjoyments.

body.text: u2.6ab/.ardha^dvitīya^gṛṣṭyā tu pinyo vāme hi yasya tu/
body.translated_text: If a mark of one-and-a-half measures appears on the left side,

body.text: u2.6cd/.ārdrāyāṃ krodhano jāto mūrkho gopatikaś ca saḥ//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Ārdrā</s> is wrathful, foolish, and a keeper of cattle.

body.text: u2.7ab/.vāme kakṣe vraṇo yasya kṛṣṇaś ca^eva punarvasau/
body.translated_text: If a dark mark appears in the left armpit, born under <s>Punarvasu</s>,

body.text: u2.7cd/.dhana^dhānya^samṛddho hi jāyate svalpa^medhasaḥ//
body.translated_text: he is rich in wealth and grain, but of little intelligence.

body.text: u2.8ab/.tathā^eva puṣye jāto +asau dṛśyate vara^lakṣaṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: One born under <s>Puṣya</s> is seen to have excellent marks —

body.text: u2.8cd/.cakra^madhye ca haste ca sūryaś candro virājate//
body.translated_text: in the center of the palm and on the hand, the sun and moon shine.

body.text: u2.9ab/.ardha^pradakṣiṇāvartāḥ keśāḥ sarve hi saṃsthitāḥ/(p.149)
body.translated_text: All the hair is arranged in half-clockwise whorls,

body.text: u2.9cd/.parimaṇḍalaś ca kāyena jitakleśo +api nāyakaḥ//
body.translated_text: the body is well-proportioned, he has conquered afflictions, and is a leader.

body.text: u2.10ab/.hṛdaye yasya dāhaḥ syād śleṣāyāṃ kali^priyaḥ/
body.translated_text: If there is a burn-mark on the heart, one born under <s>Āśleṣā</s> is fond of strife,

body.text: u2.10cd/.duḥśīlo duḥkhasaṃvāso maithunābhir ataś ca saḥ//
body.translated_text: of bad character, difficult to live with, and lustful.

body.text: u2.11ab/.adha; urasi pṛṣṭhe vā yasya vraṇaḥ pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If a mark is seen below the chest or on the back,

body.text: u2.11cd/.maghāyāṃ dhanavān jāto mahā^ātma dhārmiko naraḥ//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Maghā</s> is wealthy, great-souled, and righteous.

body.text: u2.12ab/.nābhyāṃ dakṣiṇa^vāmābhyāṃ vraṇo yasya pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If a mark is seen on the right or left side of the navel,

body.text: u2.12cd/.pūrvaphālgunījāto +asau matsarī ca^alpa^jīvitaḥ//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Pūrvaphālgunī</s> is envious and short-lived.

body.text: u2.13ab/.catur^aṅgulato nābhyā yasya pinyaḥ pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If a mark is seen four finger-breadths from the navel,

body.text: u2.13cd/.uttaraphālgunījāto bhoga^śīlaḥ śrutodyataḥ//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Uttaraphālgunī</s> is devoted to enjoyments and given to learning.

body.text: u2.14ab/.śroṇyāmalohitaḥ pinyo haste jātasya dṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If a copper-red mark on the hip is seen on the hand of one so born,

body.text: u2.14cd/.cauraḥ śaṭhaś ca māyāvī mandapuṇyo +alpa^medhasaḥ//
body.translated_text: he is a thief, deceitful, and a trickster — of little merit and little intelligence.

body.text: u2.15ab/.vyaṃjane yasya pinyas tu dṛśyate niyamenahi/
body.translated_text: If a mark is seen with certainty on the genitals,

body.text: u2.15cd/.citrā^jātaḥ sa ced rogī nṛtyagītaratas tathā//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Citrā</s> is sickly, but delights in dance and song.

body.text: u2.16ab/.vyañjane +api ca; ūrdhve vā pītaḥ pinyaḥpradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If a yellow mark is seen above or on the genitals,

body.text: u2.16cd/.jātaḥ svātyām asau lubdho guṇadviṣṭo hy apaṇḍitaḥ//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Svātī</s> is greedy, hostile to good qualities, and unlearned.

body.text: u2.17ab/.kugṛṣṭyā yasya; ūrūbhyāṃ pinyo lohita; eva hi/
body.translated_text: If on both thighs a red mark appears with a half-measure,

body.text: u2.17cd/.ākīrṇo naranārībhir viśākhāyāṃ bhaṭo +agraṇīḥ//
body.translated_text: surrounded by men and women, one born under <s>Viśākhā</s> is a foremost warrior.

body.text: u2.18ab/.vidvān śūro jitamitro nityaṃ saukhyaparāyaṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: Learned, heroic, with enemies conquered, always devoted to happiness,

body.text: u2.18cd/.śriyā dhṛtyā ca sampanno +acyutaḥ svarupapadyate//
body.translated_text: endowed with fortune and steadfastness, unfallen — he attains his own nature.

body.text: u2.19ab/.dvitīyagṛṣṭyām ūrubhyām aṅge yasya pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If at the second measure on the thighs a mark is seen on the body,

body.text: u2.19cd/.śīlavān anurādhāyāṃ dharma^bhoga^samanvitaḥ//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Anurādhā</s> is virtuous and endowed with righteousness and enjoyments.

body.text:
u2.20ab/.adho yasya^iha ca^ūrubhyāṃ pinyo jyeṣṭhe sa jāyate/
u2.20cd/.alpa^ayur apriyo duḥkhī duḥśīlaḥ kṛpaṇas tathā//
body.translated_text: If a mark is below on the thighs, one is born under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> — short-lived, unloved, suffering, of bad character, and wretched.

body.text: u2.21ab/.jānubhyām ūrdhvataḥ sūkṣmo vraṇo yasya^iha dṛśyate/(p.150)
body.translated_text: If a fine mark is seen above the knees,

body.text: u2.21cd/.mūlena bhāgyavān jātaḥ svagṛhaṃ nāśayel laghu//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Mūla</s> is fortunate but destroys his own house quickly.

body.text: u2.22ab/.pūrvāṣāḍhāsu jātasya pinyaḥ syāj jānu^maṇḍale/
body.translated_text: For one born under <s>Pūrvāṣāḍhā</s>, the mark appears on the kneecap —

body.text: u2.22cd/.dāyako dharma; āsaṅgya^cyutaḥ svargaparāyaṇaḥ//
body.translated_text: he is generous, devoted to <s>Dharma</s>, steadfast, unfallen, and destined for heaven.

body.text: u2.23ab/.uttarāyām āṣāḍhāyāṃ jātasya tilakas trike/
body.translated_text: For one born under <s>Uttarāṣāḍhā</s>, if a mark appears at the junction of three [bones],

body.text: u2.23cd/.yadi dṛśyet sa medhāvī bhogavān syāj jana^priyaḥ//
body.translated_text: he is intelligent, wealthy, and beloved by people.

body.text: u2.24ab/.dvitīyaḥ pinyo dṛśyeta dhanavān bhogavān sadā/
body.translated_text: If a second mark is seen, he is always wealthy and prosperous,

body.text: u2.24cd/.satya^priyas tathārogo +acyutaḥ svargaṃ ca gacchati//
body.translated_text: devoted to truth, healthy, unfallen, and goes to heaven.

body.text: u2.25ab/.dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ ca jaṅghāyāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pinyaḥ pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: For one born under <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>, a dark mark appears on the calf —

body.text: u2.25cd/.krodhano mandarāgaś ca prājño bhoga^vivarjitaḥ//
body.translated_text: he is wrathful, of moderate passion, intelligent, but devoid of enjoyments.

body.text: u2.26ab/.dvikugṛṣṭyā ca jaṅghāyāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pinyaḥ pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If on the calf a dark mark appears with a double half-measure,

body.text: u2.26cd/.mūrkhaḥ śatabhiṣāyāṃ tu mriyate hy adakena saḥ//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Śatabhiṣā</s> is a fool and dies by a snake-bite.

body.text: u2.27ab/.adho jaṅghāṃ kugṛṣṭyā tu pūrvabhādrapade vraṇaḥ/
body.translated_text: If below the calf with a half-measure a mark appears, born under <s>Pūrvabhādrapadā</s> —

body.text: u2.27cd/.paropatāpako mūrkho daridraś caura; ity api//
body.translated_text: he is harmful to others, foolish, poor, and even a thief.

body.text: u2.28ab/.kuguṣṭyā yasya pinyaḥ syāj jāto bhādrapada^uttare/
body.translated_text: If a mark of a half-measure appears, born under <s>Uttarabhādrapadā</s> —

body.text: u2.28cd/.dānaśīlaḥ smṛtiprāpto dayāpanno viśāradaḥ//
body.translated_text: he is generous, possessed of good memory, compassionate, and skilled.

body.text: u2.29ab/.ubhayoḥ pādayoḥ sūkṣmaḥ pinyo yasya pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If a fine mark is seen on both feet,

body.text: u2.29cd/.revatyāṃ jāyate nīco nāpitaḥ sa havaty api//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Revatī</s> is low-born and may even be a barber.

body.text: u2.30ab/.aṅguṣṭhavivare pinyo nīlo yasya pradṛśyate/
body.translated_text: If a blue mark is seen in the space between the big toes,

body.text: u2.30cd/.arogo balavān nityam aśvinyāṃ jāta; eva saḥ//
body.translated_text: one born under <s>Aśvinī</s> is always healthy and strong.

body.text: u2.31ab/.atha pāṇitale pinyo bharaṇyām akṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ/
body.translated_text: A mark on the palm, born under <s>Bharaṇī</s>, is known as imperishable —

body.text: u2.31cd/.vadhyaghātaś ca duḥśīlaḥ syān narakaparāyaṇaḥ//
body.translated_text: but he is violent, of bad character, and destined for hell.

body.text: u2.32ab/.nakṣatrāṇāṃ padaṃ hy etad yena caryā prajāyate/
body.translated_text: This is the position of the <s>nakṣatras</s> (lunar mansions) by which one's destiny is determined.

body.text: u2.32cd/.etad dhi loka^prajñānaṃ loko yatra samāśritaḥ//iti pinyādhyāyāḥ//
body.translated_text: This is the knowledge of the world, upon which the world depends. Thus ends the chapter on bodily marks.

body.text: u2.33/.atha khalu bhoḥ puṣkarasārin piṭakādhyāyaṃ nāma^adhyāyaṃ vyākhāsyāmi/ tac chrūyatāṃ/ kathayatu bhagavān trisaṅkuḥ/(p.151)
body.translated_text: Now then, O <s>Puṣkarasārin</s>, I shall explain the chapter called 'Chapter on Boils' (<s>Piṭakādhyāya</s>). Listen to it. Let the lord speak, said <s>Triśaṅku</s>.

body.text: u3 piṭakādhyāyaḥ
body.translated_text: Chapter 3: The Chapter on Boils (<s>Piṭakādhyāya</s>)

body.text: u3.1ab/.ataḥ ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarva^sthāna^gataṃ punaḥ/
body.translated_text: Henceforth I shall declare what pertains to all bodily locations,

body.text: u3.1cd/.strīṇāṃ ca puruṣāṇāṃ ca piṭakaṃ sarva^karmakaṃ//
body.translated_text: the boil that indicates all outcomes, for women and men alike.

body.text: u3.2ab/.lābha^alābhaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā/
body.translated_text: Gain and loss, happiness and suffering, life and death —

body.text: u3.2cd/.prājñā yenābhijānanti taṃ ca sarvaṃ nibodhatāṃ//
body.translated_text: by which the wise may discern all this, understand that.

body.text: u3.3ab/.tatrābhighātadagdhā vā tilās tad rūpakā; api/
body.translated_text: Among these, marks caused by injury or burning, sesame-shaped ones,

body.text: u3.3cd/.visphoṭavarnabhedāś ca piṭakābhihitāḥ smṛtāḥ//
body.translated_text: blisters, discolorations, and skin-breaks — these are called <s>piṭakas</s> (boils).

body.text: u3.4ab/.śvetavarṇena piṭako viprāṇāṃ pūjito bhavet/
body.translated_text: A white-colored <s>piṭaka</s> is auspicious for <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>;

body.text: u3.4cd/.kṣatopamaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ vaiśyānāṃ pītakaḥ smṛtaḥ//
body.translated_text: one resembling a wound is for <s>Kṣatriyas</s>; a yellowish one is prescribed for <s>Vaiśyas</s>.

body.text: u3.5ab/.śūdrāṇām asitaḥ śreṣṭho vivarṇo mleccha^jātiṣu/
body.translated_text: A dark one is best for <s>Śūdras</s>; a discolored one for <s>Mleccha</s> (foreign) peoples.

body.text: u3.5cd/.yadā savarṇa^piṭako mūrdhni rājā mahān smṛtaḥ/
body.translated_text: When a <s>piṭaka</s> matching one's <s>varṇa</s> appears on the head, one is known as a great king.
